Available in two shades, it features Aqua Booster Technology that strengthens UV protection when exposed to water or sweat. The cream-type foundation offers natural coverage with a ceramic-like finish that lasts up to 8 hours. With 50% skincare ingredients and a pleasant citrus fragrance, it's ideal for busy mornings and outdoor activities.

Name: KISSME Heroine Make Set of 2, Volume Up Mascara & Mascara Remover
Short description: This is a popular Japanese mascara set from KissMe Heroine Make, featuring their signature Volume Up Super Waterproof Mascara paired with a Speedy Mascara Remover. The mascara delivers dramatic volume and long-lasting curl with superior waterproof performance, enriched with six types of eyelash-nourishing ingredients including camellia oil and royal jelly extract. The companion remover instantly dissolves the waterproof formula without rubbing, making it perfect for those who need their mascara to withstand tears, sweat, and humidity while wanting easy removal at day's end.

Name: Yamamoto Kanpo Sugar Off Tea 10gx24 Bags
Short description: Yamamoto Kanpo Sugar Flow Tea is a Japanese herbal blend designed to help manage blood sugar levels naturally. Each box contains 24 tea bags of 10g each, combining 12 carefully selected ingredients including mulberry leaf, oolong tea, brown rice, barley, and gymnema sylvestre. This low-calorie tea can be enjoyed hot or cold and is particularly suitable for those concerned about sugar intake or looking to support their dietary habits. The tea offers a pleasant, mild flavor that pairs well with meals and provides a convenient way to supplement a health-conscious lifestyle.

Name: Yamamoto Kanpo Fat Reduce Tea 10gx24 Bags
Short description: Yamamoto Kanpo Fat Flow Tea is a Japanese health tea blend specifically designed for people who enjoy fatty foods and are concerned about their fat intake. This 24-bag pack contains a carefully selected mixture of 11 natural ingredients including Eucommia leaves, oolong tea, pu-erh tea, green tea extract, barley, and brown rice. The tea can be enjoyed hot or cold, making it versatile year-round. Each tea bag makes approximately 0.9L of tea and is tested for 230 types of residual pesticides.

Name: Breath Care Mint, 50 Tablets
Short description: Breath Care Mint by Kobayashi Pharmaceutical is a Japanese breath-freshening supplement in capsule form. Each pack contains 50 mint-flavored capsules designed to refresh breath from inside the stomach rather than just masking mouth odors. The capsules are meant to be swallowed whole with water, particularly after consuming foods with strong odors like garlic or after drinking alcohol. The recommended dosage is 2-3 capsules per use, or 3-4 capsules when stronger freshening is desired. The portable container makes it convenient for on-the-go use.

Name: Febreze Disinfecting and Deodorizing Spray for Cloth 370ml + Febreze Toilet Freshener x2 [Blue Savon & Lavender Scent]
Short description: This is a special bundle pack of Febreze products featuring their signature W (double-action) fabric spray and toilet fresheners. The fabric spray combines disinfecting and deodorizing properties with 3D penetration technology that reaches deep into fabric fibers, eliminating bacteria and viruses while providing up to 72 hours of protection. The set includes a 370ml fabric spray and two toilet fresheners in Blue Savon and Lavender scents. Perfect for households looking for comprehensive odor control and sanitization for both fabrics and bathroom spaces.

Name: Biore Black Friday Set of 5, Hand Soap, Hand Soap Refill, Body Soap, Body Sheet, Fabric Sheet
Short description: The Biore Black Friday Limited Edition Set is a special holiday bundle featuring essential personal care items from the popular Japanese brand Biore. The set includes hand soap with pump dispenser, hand soap refill, body wash, body cleansing sheets, and fabric freshening sheets. Known for their gentle formulations and effective cleansing properties, these products are perfect for daily hygiene routines. The set makes an excellent gift or personal care starter pack for those who appreciate Japanese skincare quality.

Name: Coenrich The Premium Medicated Wrinkle White Hand Cream, Peach Scent
Short description: This is a premium Japanese medicated hand cream by Kose Cosmeport that combines anti-aging and whitening properties. The key ingredient is Coenzyme Q10 along with niacinamide, which helps improve wrinkles and prevent dark spots. It features a rich, non-greasy texture that deeply moisturizes while caring for nails and cuticles. The cream has a fresh peach fragrance and is particularly suitable for those concerned about aging signs on their hands, such as dryness, loss of firmness, and hyperpigmentation. This is a quasi-drug product approved in Japan.

Name: The Stem Cell White Face Mask Premium 30 sheets
Short description: The Stem Cell White Face Mask is a premium Japanese sheet mask set containing 30 pieces. The mask features a unique blend of human and plant stem cell culture solutions, combined with Black Pearl Extract, Fermented Yeast Cell Extract, Hyaluronic Acid, and Nano Collagen. Designed for 5-10 minutes of use after cleansing, it aims to provide deep hydration, improve skin elasticity, and promote a brighter complexion. Best suited for those seeking intensive skin rejuvenation and brightening effects.

Name: Coenrich Medicated Whitening Hand Cream Peach Fragrance
Short description: This is a Japanese medicated hand cream by Kose Cosmeport that combines anti-aging and whitening benefits. The formula features microencapsulated Coenzyme Q10, niacinamide, and three nourishing oils including jojoba and royal jelly. It helps prevent dark spots and sun damage while deeply moisturizing without feeling greasy. The cream has a fresh peach fragrance and is particularly suitable for those concerned with aging hands, dryness, and uneven skin tone. Best for all skin types seeking both hydration and brightening effects.

Name: Ichikami Premium Hair Treatment Mask, Damage Repair 200g
Short description: The Ichikami Premium Hair Treatment Mask is a Japanese sulfate-free hair mask designed for damaged hair repair and deep moisturizing. Its unique "Wrapping System" technology combines five premium Japanese botanical oils, including rice bran, safflower, and camellia oils, to penetrate deeply into hair strands. The rich, creamy texture provides salon-like results, leaving hair silky smooth and manageable. Best suited for those with dry, damaged, or coarse hair. Features an elegant cherry blossom fragrance and comes in a 200g jar.

Name: Marukyu Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Wako 40g Can
Short description: Wako is a premium ceremonial grade matcha powder produced by Marukyu Koyamaen, one of Japan's most prestigious tea manufacturers from Uji, Kyoto. This 40g can contains a light vibrant green powder characterized by its refreshing aroma and smooth finish. It offers a balanced flavor profile with subtle nutty notes, mild sweetness, and minimal bitterness. Perfect for daily matcha drinkers who prefer a stronger matcha taste, it's excellent for both traditional preparation (usucha) and matcha lattes. The powder maintains freshness for approximately 7 months when properly stored.

Name: Ipoddo Tea Matcha Powder, Ikuyo-no-mukashi 30g Box
Short description: Ikuyo-no-mukashi (幾世の昔) is a premium ceremonial grade matcha green tea powder from Ippodo Tea, a renowned 300-year-old Kyoto tea house. This versatile 30g matcha features a smooth, balanced flavor profile with subtle sweetness, gentle umami, and minimal astringency. It's particularly well-suited for beginners and daily matcha drinkers, perfect for both traditional usucha (thin tea) preparation and modern applications like lattes. The powder has a vibrant green color and pairs excellently with both traditional Japanese sweets and contemporary desserts.

Name: Yoseka Matcha Whisk, Chasen, Tea Ceremony
Short description: This is a traditional Japanese bamboo matcha whisk (chasen) with 100 tines, specifically designed for preparing matcha green tea. The white bamboo whisk features delicate prongs split from a single piece of bamboo, making it ideal for creating smooth, frothy matcha. Its 100-tine design offers optimal foam creation and is particularly suitable for preparing usucha (thin matcha tea). Perfect for both tea ceremony practitioners and home users, the whisk comes in a protective clear case to maintain its shape when not in use.

Name: ReFa Heart Brush (Champagne Gold) MTG MTI Hair Brush Gift Present
Short description: The ReFa Heart Brush is a premium Japanese hair brush with an elegant heart-shaped design. Its innovative three-tier bristle structure simultaneously detangles and polishes hair, leaving it smooth and shiny with minimal damage. The brush features round-tipped pins that gently stimulate the scalp while brushing. It comes with a protective cover for convenient portability. Available in six luxurious colors including Champagne Gold, this brush is perfect for those seeking both style and functionality in their daily hair care routine.

Name: Himecoto White Armpit Princess Night Pack, Blackheads on the Armpits and Sleeping Beauty
Short description: Himecoto White Armpit Princess Night Pack is a Japanese skincare product designed to address underarm discoloration and texture concerns while you sleep. This non-greasy cream contains placenta extract for whitening and glycyrrhizic acid for anti-inflammatory effects. Applied before bedtime, it works overnight to brighten dark areas, reduce melanin production, and moisturize the skin. The lavender and bergamot-scented formula is best suited for those dealing with underarm darkening from shaving or friction, though it may not be suitable for sensitive skin.

Name: &Honey Melty Moist Hand Cream (Moisturized), Pink Rose Honey Fragrance, 1.8 oz (50 g)
Short description: The &honey Melty Moist Hand Cream is a Japanese beauty product featuring a unique blend of three honey types: 50% Manuka honey from New Zealand, 30% rose honey from Bulgaria, and 20% raw honey from Japan. This lightweight formula contains over 90% hydrating ingredients, including argan oil, propolis, and royal jelly. With its delicate pink rose honey fragrance, the cream absorbs quickly without stickiness while brightening skin tone. Best suited for those seeking a non-greasy hand cream with gentle moisturizing properties and a subtle floral-honey scent.

Name: &Honey Deep Moist Lovely Heart Limited Pair Set (Disney Collaboration)
Short description: This is a limited edition Disney collaboration hair care set from the Japanese brand &honey. The set features shampoo and treatment bottles adorned with Disney character designs in pink packaging. The products are specifically formulated for dry and unruly hair, containing honey and moisture-retaining ingredients. With a sweet berry-honey fragrance, this hair care system helps control frizz while providing deep hydration. It's particularly suitable for those seeking to achieve smooth, manageable hair with a pleasant sweet scent.

Name: &Honey Pixie Marie-chan Limited Pair Set [Shampoo/Treatment/4step Travel Kit]
Short description: This is a limited edition Disney Marie-themed hair care set from &honey Pixie, a Japanese beauty brand known for its honey-based formulations. The set includes a shampoo (440ml), treatment (440g), and a travel-sized kit. Featuring cashmere silk formula and three types of honey, it's designed to combat frizz and tangles while providing superior moisture. The product offers a luxurious "Chantilly Fleur Honey" fragrance that combines floral notes with honey. Best suited for those seeking smoother, more manageable hair with a silky finish.

Name: &Honey Pixie Moist Silky Sakura Limited Pair Set [Shampoo/Treatment/4 step Travel Kit]
Short description: This is a limited edition 2024 &Honey Sakura Pixie Moist Silky hair care set featuring a shampoo (440ml) and treatment (440g), plus a 4-step travel kit. The set is designed for those with tangled, dry hair, featuring a sweet Yaezakura honey fragrance. The formula contains three types of honey, organic ingredients, and sakura extracts to provide deep moisture and create silky, manageable hair. The packaging showcases a charming pink sakura design with cat-shaped pump tops, making it both functional and decorative.

Name: Off & Relax Spa Shampoo Treatment, Cherry Blossom Limited Set (260 ml)
Short description: Off & Relax's Cherry Blossom Limited Set features a shampoo and treatment duo in 260ml bottles. This seasonal product captures the essence of early-blooming cherry blossoms with a sweet, floral scent. The formula contains double cherry blossom extract and sake lees extract to deeply repair damaged hair. It also includes evening primrose seed extract to improve scalp health. This set is ideal for those seeking hair repair and a luxurious, spring-inspired hair care experience.

Name: Botanist Rooth Treatment, Straight, Aging Care
Short description: BOTANIST ROOTH is a premium Japanese hair care line specifically designed for aging hair concerns. This treatment system features a unique carbonated ginger formula that revitalizes the scalp while providing deep moisturization. The straight variant helps manage frizz and adds shine to mature hair. With a refreshing blend of grapefruit and ginger fragrance, it's particularly suitable for those experiencing age-related hair changes like dryness and loss of luster. The treatment penetrates deeply into the scalp and hair cuticles to restore natural beauty from root to tip.

Name: Nivea Premium Whitening Body Lotion + Mini Nivea UV Deep Protect & Care
Short description: The Nivea Premium Whitening Body Milk is a Japanese body lotion designed for those concerned about dryness and dullness. It features vitamin C derivatives to suppress melanin production and prevent dark spots, while the Premium Glow Line ingredients (glycerin, glycogen, and glyceryl glucoside) provide long-lasting moisture with a glossy finish. The formula has a light, non-sticky texture and features an elegant citrus and rose fragrance. Best suited for those seeking brightening effects while maintaining deep hydration. The package includes a mini UV Deep Protect & Care product for comprehensive skin protection.

Name: Diane Botanical Body Milk, Citrus Herb Scent, 500ml
Short description: Diane Botanical Body Milk is a Japanese-made moisturizing body lotion featuring a refreshing citrus herb fragrance. This 500ml product contains whipped shea butter and botanical ceramides for deep hydration without feeling sticky. Made with over 90% natural ingredients including 10 organic botanical extracts, it's suitable for sensitive skin and family use. The formula is free from sulfates, parabens, synthetic dyes, mineral oils, ethanol, and animal-derived ingredients, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a gentle, natural body care solution.

Name: Nivea Premium Moisture Body Lotion 190g
Short description: Nivea Premium Body Milk is a Japanese high-moisture body lotion that comes in several variants including Whitening, Repair, and Moisture. This premium body milk features a lightweight, non-sticky texture while providing intense hydration for all-day moisture retention. It contains premium ingredients like glycerin, glycogen, and vitamin C derivatives. The formula helps maintain skin barrier function and creates a glossy, healthy-looking finish. Best suited for those concerned with dry skin, dullness, or seeking skin brightening effects. Available in an elegant rose and citrus fragrance or unscented versions.

Name: Schick Intuition Moist Skin Razor (with Blade)
Short description: The Schick Intuition Moisturizing Razor is an all-in-one shaving solution featuring a 4-blade pivoting head surrounded by a built-in moisturizing soap bar enriched with shea butter, jojoba oil, and oat extracts. This innovative design eliminates the need for separate shaving gel or cream. The razor includes safety wires for skin protection, a rubber handle for secure grip, and releases a pleasant floral fragrance while shaving. It's particularly well-suited for travelers or those seeking a quick, convenient shaving experience while maintaining skin hydration.

Name: KOSÉ Clear Turn Mask Pore Care Limited Sakura
Short description: This is a limited edition KOSE Clear Turn Keana Komachi (Pore Care) Sheet Mask with Cherry Blossom scent. The mask features Japanese sakura extract and a dual-action formula combining fermented rice extract and CICA to address both pore concerns and rough skin caused by dryness and excess sebum. The moisturizing essence balances skin's water and oil content to achieve smooth, porcelain-like skin. Designed in collaboration with illustrator yasuna, the packaging depicts a cherry blossom theme. The mask is free from colorants, mineral oils, parabens, UV absorbers, and silicone, making it suitable for those seeking gentle yet effective pore care.

Name: Quality 1st The Derma Mask 30 Sheets
Short description: The Quality 1st The Derma Mask is a premium Japanese sheet mask set containing 30 pieces. This highly moisturizing facial mask features 4% niacinamide, concentrated galactomyces, 11 amino acids, and 6 types of ceramides. Each mask is generously soaked in essence and designed to provide intense hydration while gently exfoliating the skin. The 3-minute treatment aims to improve skin texture, firmness, and radiance. Best suited for those seeking daily intensive moisture and gentle skin barrier repair.

Name: TSUBAKI Premium EX Intensive Repair Shampoo Treatment Set
Short description: The TSUBAKI Premium EX Intensive Repair Shampoo & Treatment Set is a premium Japanese hair care duo designed for damaged hair repair. The black bottles contain innovative ionic repair technology and luxurious ingredients including camellia oil, royal jelly, and hyaluronic acid. This set penetrates deeply to restore damaged hair, providing intensive moisture and leaving hair smooth and glossy. The formula features a sophisticated rose bouquet and camellia fragrance. Ideal for those with dry, brittle, or chemically-treated hair seeking salon-quality restoration.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Ogurayama 30g Can
Short description: Ogurayama is a premium ceremonial grade matcha powder from Yamamasa Koyamaen, a renowned tea producer in Uji, Kyoto. It's a well-balanced usucha (thin tea) with a rich, full-bodied aroma and creamy, sweet flavor profile. The matcha features mild, delicate notes without excessive bitterness, making it ideal for both beginners and experienced matcha drinkers

Name: Yamamasa Koyaemaen Matcha Powder, Shikibu No Mukashi 30g Can
Short description: Shikibu no Mukashi is a premium ceremonial grade matcha green tea powder produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a renowned tea manufacturer in Uji, Kyoto since the Edo period. This 30g can contains high-grade matcha ideal for preparing both usucha (thin tea) and koicha (thick tea). It offers a rich, intensely creamy texture with a deep umami flavor profile and subtle notes of toasted seeds. The matcha has a lingering sweet aftertaste and is particularly well-suited for tea ceremonies and traditional preparation. It's perfect for matcha enthusiasts seeking an authentic, high-quality Japanese tea experience.

Name: Seria Oil Stain Removal Sheets, Kitchen Cleaning Sheets, 46 Sheets
Short description: These are specialized cleaning sheets designed to effectively remove oil and grease stains in the kitchen. Each pack contains 46 disposable sheets that can be used to wipe down oily surfaces, kitchen counters, stovetops, and other kitchen areas. They're convenient for quick cleanup and help maintain kitchen cleanliness by absorbing and removing oil residue.

Name: Kao 8x4 Powder Spray, Rose & Verbena Scent 150g
Short description: The Kao 8x4 Powder Spray in Rose & Verbena scent is a Japanese antiperspirant body spray that provides all-over deodorant protection. This medical-grade product features natural licorice-derived antibacterial BGA (β-glycyrrhetinic acid) and green tea essence for odor control. The formula includes botanical powder that absorbs excess oil, leaving skin feeling fresh and dry. Ideal for underarms, neck, chest, and back areas where sweat and stickiness are concerns. The feminine rose and verbena fragrance offers a delicate botanical aroma.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Matsukaze 30g Can
Short description: Matsukaze (松風) is a ceremonial grade matcha green tea powder produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a prestigious tea manufacturer from Uji, Kyoto. This entry-level usucha (thin tea) offers a mellow taste with subdued bitterness and astringency, making it exceptionally approachable for daily drinking. Its smooth, well-balanced flavor profile features subtle umami notes with a hint of creaminess. Perfect for traditional tea preparation, culinary use, or as an introduction to authentic Japanese matcha for beginners.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Yomo No Kaori 30g Can
Short description: Yomo No Kaori is a premium ceremonial grade matcha green tea powder produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a renowned tea manufacturer from Uji, Kyoto, with roots dating back to the Edo period. This matcha is characterized by its rich, full-bodied aroma and mellow taste with a refreshing finish. The name "Yomo no Kaori" (四方の薫) means "fragrance from all directions," reflecting its well-balanced aromatic profile. Best suited for traditional tea ceremony as usucha (thin tea) and also excellent for high-end lattes and sweets. The product comes in a 30g can with an 8-month shelf life and is made from 100% Japanese green tea leaves.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Samidori 30g Can
Short description: This is Samidori, a ceremonial grade matcha green tea powder produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a prestigious tea manufacturer from Uji, Kyoto, with roots dating back to the Edo period. The 30g can contains a high-quality matcha known for its vibrant green color, smooth taste, and balanced flavor profile with subdued bitterness and astringency. It's particularly well-suited for preparing usucha (thin tea) and is versatile enough for both traditional tea ceremony preparation and modern culinary applications like baking or lattes. This matcha is an excellent choice for both matcha beginners and enthusiasts seeking an authentic Japanese tea experience.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Samidori 100g Bag
Short description: Samidori is a ceremonial grade matcha powder produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a prestigious tea manufacturer in Uji, Kyoto since the Edo period. This medium-bodied green tea powder offers a balanced flavor profile with reduced bitterness and astringency, making it approachable for both beginners and enthusiasts. It features chocolatey and nutty notes with a creamy texture. Perfect for daily drinking as usucha (thin tea), it's also versatile enough for culinary applications like lattes and sweets.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Matsukaze 100g Bag
Short description: Matsukaze (松風) is a ceremonial-grade matcha powder produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a historic tea manufacturer from Uji, Kyoto, established in the Edo period. This entry-level ceremonial matcha offers a balanced profile with mild bitterness, subtle sweetness, and a fresh green tea flavor. While suitable for traditional tea ceremonies and daily drinking, it's also commonly used in cafes and confectionery. The powder is made from 100% Japanese green tea leaves, ground using traditional stone mill techniques, making it ideal for both casual matcha enthusiasts and culinary applications.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Shikibu No Mukashi 150g Can
Short description: This is a premium ceremonial grade matcha powder called "Shikibu No Mukashi" produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a renowned tea manufacturer in Uji, Kyoto. It features a well-balanced harmony of rich umami and delicate sweetness with minimal bitterness, creating a mellow, smooth taste. This matcha is primarily used for tea ceremonies and is considered a high-grade usucha (thin tea), though it can also be enjoyed as koicha (thick tea) at home. The powder has a shelf life of approximately 8 months and comes in a traditional gold-colored metal can.

Name: Marukyu Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Isuzu 40g Can
Short description: This is Isuzu (五十鈴), a premium ceremonial grade matcha green tea powder produced by Marukyu Koyamaen, a renowned tea company with over 300 years of history in Uji, Kyoto. The matcha features a distinctive profile with a refreshing aroma, astringent taste, and subtle umami flavor with slight bitterness. Named after the Isuzu River near Ise Shrine, this versatile matcha is best prepared slightly diluted and works excellently both as a traditional tea ceremony grade matcha or mixed with milk for lattes and confectionery. The 40g can is designed for optimal freshness preservation and should be stored in a cool, dark place.

Name: Marukyu Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Isuzu 100g Bag
Short description: Isuzu is a ceremonial grade matcha powder produced by Marukyu Koyamaen, a prestigious tea manufacturer in Uji, Kyoto. This bold matcha is characterized by its sharp, tart amino acids and a balanced profile of refreshing aroma, astringent umami, and slight bitterness. Best suited for making usucha (thin tea) or in lattes and sweetened beverages. For a smoother taste, it can be prepared with lower temperature water (70°C). The powder comes in a 100g bag with a 7-month shelf life.

Name: Ito Kanpo Pharmaceutical Black Oolong Tea 42 Bags
Short description: This is a premium black oolong tea produced by Ito Kampo Pharmaceutical, a Japanese herbal medicine company. The tea uses 100% Narcissus variety oolong tea leaves sourced from Fujian Province, China. Each box contains 42 tea bags (5g each) that can be prepared through hot brewing, cold brewing, or traditional steeping methods. Known for its clean, refreshing taste, this tea is particularly well-suited to accompany oily or fried foods. It's designed as a daily wellness tea that combines traditional Chinese tea craftsmanship with Japanese quality standards, making it perfect for health-conscious consumers looking for a smooth, full-bodied oolong tea.

Name: Premium Aroma, Simple Modern Velvet Musk, Room Fragrance 400ml
Short description: This is a premium home air freshener and deodorizer from S.T. Corporation Japan, featuring a sophisticated Velvet Musk fragrance. The product combines oriental floral notes inspired by urban luxury interiors, creating a modern and elegant atmosphere. It contains nanopowder technology that effectively absorbs and breaks down unpleasant odors while releasing a perfume-like scent. The sleek, minimalist black design complements contemporary home décor. With a 400ml capacity, the fragrance typically lasts 2-3 months, making it ideal for living rooms, entrances, and spaces where a refined ambiance is desired.

Name: &Honey Sakura Pixie Moist Silky Shampoo Refill
Short description: The &honey Sakura Pixie Moist Silky Shampoo Refill is a limited edition Japanese hair care product featuring a sweet Yaezakura honey fragrance. This moisturizing shampoo contains over 90% hydrating ingredients, including honey, royal jelly, and Moroccan argan oil. It's specially formulated with cashmere silk components to combat tangling and frizz while maintaining 14% hair moisture content. Best suited for those with dry, tangled, or fine hair, the shampoo aims to deliver a silky, smooth finish from root to tip. The product follows a natural-focused approach with organic ingredients and is free from sulfates, parabens, mineral oils, synthetic antioxidants, and animal testing.

Name: &Honey Sakura Pixie Moist Silky Treatment Refill
Short description: The &Honey Sakura Pixie Moist Silky Treatment is a premium Japanese hair treatment refill featuring a cherry blossom (sakura) limited edition design. This moisturizing hair treatment is specially formulated with honey-derived ingredients and cashmere-silk proteins to transform dry, tangled hair into a smooth, silky texture. The product is particularly effective for those with frizzy or unmanageable hair, providing deep hydration and a pleasant sweet cherry blossom honey fragrance. It's part of &Honey's luxury haircare line and is best suited for those seeking intensive moisture and improved hair manageability while enjoying a sophisticated Japanese beauty experience.

Name: [40% Off] Jvature Advanced Brightening Set Full Box Toner 120ml, Serum 50ml, Moisturizer 100ml
Short description: The Advanced Brightening Set represents their commitment to clean beauty principles, combining natural ingredients with modern skincare technology.
