Their products are developed using sustainable natural methods combined with contemporary scientific techniques. The company is based in Songdo, Incheon, South Korea, and emphasizes clean, vegan formulations in their skincare line. Recently collaborated with Japanese market.

Name: &Honey Melty Moist Repair Hair Oil [Beauty and the beast limited edition]
Short description: This is a limited edition Disney Beauty and the Beast collaboration hair oil from the Japanese brand &honey Melty. The 100ml product features a luxurious formula enriched with three types of honey and rose extracts, designed to provide deep moisture and control frizz while taming wavy or unruly hair. The special La Belle Rose Honey fragrance combines sweet honey with elegant rose notes. The product is particularly effective during humid seasons and helps maintain straight, manageable hair. The bottle showcases an enchanting Beauty and the Beast design, making it both functional and decorative for your vanity.

Name: &Honey Deep Moist Hair Oil Pine Amé Limited Edition
Short description: This is a limited edition hair oil from the Japanese haircare brand &Honey, created in collaboration with Pine Ame (a classic Japanese pineapple candy). The product combines the brand's signature honey-based moisturizing formula with a unique pineapple candy fragrance. The hair oil is designed to combat frizz and dryness while providing deep moisture and shine. It features a special blend of three types of honey for enhanced hydration. The retro-cute packaging design reflects the nostalgic Pine Ame candy aesthetic. Best suited for those seeking intensive moisture treatment for dry, damaged hair while enjoying a sweet, nostalgic scent.

Name: &Honey Marie Chan Pixie Moist Silky Hair Oil
Short description: The &Honey Marie Chan Pixie Moist Silky Hair Oil is a limited edition hair treatment featuring Disney's Marie from "The Aristocats" in its design. This Japanese hair oil is specially formulated with three types of honey, cashmere silk proteins, and protective ingredients that make up over 90% of the product. It's particularly effective for taming flyaway hair and adding silkiness without feeling heavy. The oil features a sweet floral honey fragrance called "Shanti Fleur Honey." Best suited for those with fine, frizzy, or difficult-to-manage hair who want a lightweight, non-greasy solution for smoother, more manageable locks.

Name: Nivea Rich Care & Color Sheer Red
Short description: The Nivea Rich Care & Color Lip in Sheer Red is a Japanese tinted lip balm that combines skincare and color. This 2g stick features a moisturizing formula with three beauty oils (macadamia nut, avocado, and jojoba) for smooth application and nourishment. The sheer red tint provides a natural, glossy finish while enhancing lip color. With SPF20 PA++ protection, it guards against UV damage. The fragrance-free formula is particularly suitable for those seeking daily lip care with a touch of color, especially those with dry or chapped lips who want a natural-looking enhancement.

Name: Nivea Rich Care & Color French Pink
Short description: Nivea Rich Care & Color Lip in French Pink is a tinted lip balm that combines moisturizing care with a natural color enhancement. This Japanese product features three beauty oils (macadamia nut, avocado, and jojoba) for deep hydration while providing a subtle coral-pink tint with a glossy finish. The melting texture spreads smoothly on lips, creating a plump, dewy appearance. With SPF20 PA++ protection and fragrance-free formula, it's perfect for those seeking a natural-looking lip product that offers both color and care. Ideal for daily use, especially in professional settings where subtle makeup is preferred.

Name: Canmake Glow Fleur Cheeks 02
Canmake Powder Cheeks P02
Nivea Moist Pure Color Apricot Pink
Short description: The Nivea Moist Pure Color Lip Balm in Apricot Pink is a Japanese tinted lip balm that combines skincare and subtle color. This 3.5g stick features SPF20 PA++ UV protection and contains key moisturizing ingredients including hyaluronic acid, amino acids, and botanical extracts from Panax ginseng root. The formula includes light-diffusing powder that helps minimize the appearance of vertical lip lines while providing a natural, healthy-looking tint. Best suited for those seeking a moisturizing everyday lip product with subtle color payoff and sun protection. The product is fragrance-free and ideal for creating a natural, healthy-looking finish while treating dry lips.

Name: CANMAKE Cream Cheek M01
Canmake Mellow Dew Lip Mask 01 Clear Pink
Short description: The Canmake Mellow Dew Lip Mask in Clear Pink is a fragrance-free intensive moisturizing lip treatment from Japan. This velvety-smooth lip mask melts upon contact with body temperature, creating a dewy protective film that seals in moisture and combats dryness. It comes with a built-in spatula for hygienic application and provides a subtle pink tint. Perfect for overnight intensive conditioning or as a daytime lip primer, it helps soften hard skin, reduce fine lines, and improve lipstick adherence.

Name: Himecoto Bikini Princess Scrub 35g
Short description: Himecoto Bikini Princess Scrub is a specialized V-line care product from Japan. This gentle foaming scrub is designed to address darkening and dullness in the bikini area through its unique cream-like texture. The formula contains mannan scrub to catch impurities, absorption powder (kaolin and sodium bicarbonate) for gentle exfoliation of old keratin, and super hyaluronic acid for moisture retention. The product is best suited for those looking to brighten and care for their intimate areas, with recommended use of 1-2 times per week on wet skin. The gentle massage application takes just 10-20 seconds followed by a thorough rinse.

Name: Diane Bonheur Dry Shampoo Mild Scent 120ml
Short description: Diane Bonheur Dry Shampoo is a Japanese hair and body refreshing mist made with over 98% natural ingredients. This versatile product effectively absorbs excess oil and refreshes both hair and scalp while doubling as a body mist (not for face use). Available in several fragrances including Snow Rose, Blue Jasmine & Mint, Fresh Pear & Mint, and Mild Scent, it's perfect for quick touch-ups between washes. The mild scent version features a subtle mint fragrance, making it ideal for those who prefer lighter scents. Best suited for busy individuals seeking a natural, eco-friendly solution for refreshing their hair and body on the go.

Name: Diane Bonheur Dry Shampoo Snow Rose Scent 120ml
Short description: The Diane Bonheur Dry Shampoo Snow Rose Scent is a versatile Japanese hair care product that offers a quick refresh solution for both hair and body. This multi-purpose mist features a delicate snow rose fragrance blended with natural ingredients, providing a refreshing sensation similar to post-shampooing. The formula is designed to combat sweat and greasiness while leaving a pleasant floral scent. Perfect for on-the-go touch-ups, gym sessions, or whenever washing isn't immediately possible. It's particularly suitable for those seeking a natural-based dry shampoo with a sophisticated rose fragrance. The product can be used on both hair and body, though it should not be applied to the face.

Name: Pair Acne Cream 24g
Short description: Lion Pair Acne Cream W is a Japanese over-the-counter acne medication that effectively treats inflammatory acne and pimples through a dual-action formula. Its key active ingredients are ibuprofen piconol (IPPN) for anti-inflammatory effects and isopropyl methylphenol (IPMP) for antibacterial action. The cream becomes transparent upon application, making it suitable for use under makeup. It has a mild plant-based fragrance and a skin-friendly weakly acidic pH. Best suited for treating both white and red acne, particularly effective for inflammatory acne with redness and swelling. The cream is non-sticky, gentle on skin, and can be used multiple times daily after cleansing.

Name: Lululun Exosome Hydra-EX-Mask 7 Sheets
Short description: The LuLuLun Hydra EX Mask is a Japanese daily anti-aging sheet mask featuring advanced exosome technology and glutathione. This innovative face mask combines regenerative ingredients with deep hydration to address aging concerns like sagging, loss of firmness, and dullness. The mask uses a specially developed "melty feel" sheet that adheres comfortably to the skin. Best suited for mature or dry skin types seeking improved elasticity, radiance, and moisture retention. Each mask should be worn for 10-15 minutes as part of a daily skincare routine.

Name: LuLuLun Hydra V Mask Vitamin 7 Sheets
Short description: The Lululun Hydra V Mask is a premium Japanese sheet mask designed for comprehensive skincare. This innovative facial mask features a unique HIFU-inspired stretchable sheet that provides a lifting sensation while delivering intense hydration. Formulated with 7 vitamins and 7 herbal extracts, it targets multiple skin concerns including pore visibility, dryness, and dullness. The mask is particularly effective for those seeking a "water-glow" complexion with minimized pores. Each mask contains a generous amount of essence and is designed to adhere upward for a lifting effect. Best suited for those wanting an all-in-one solution for hydration, pore care, and skin firming in a daily-use format.

Name: Quality 1st The Derma VC100 + Retinol Mask 7 Sheets
Short description: The Quality 1st Derma Laser Super Retinol 100 Mask is a Japanese nighttime sheet mask designed for intensive anti-aging care. This premium mask features a high concentration of stabilized retinol and uses unique nanocapsule penetration technology to enhance skin firmness and elasticity. The cotton-derived long-fiber nonwoven sheet provides excellent adhesion and absorption. Free from preservatives, alcohol, synthetic colorants, fragrances, and mineral oils, it takes just 3 minutes to use. Best suited for those concerned with aging signs like fine lines and wrinkles, seeking improved skin texture and firmness. Each package contains 7 masks.

Name: Yamamasa Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Tennouzan 30g
Short description: Tennouzan is a premium ceremonial-grade matcha powder produced by Yamamasa Koyamaen, a renowned tea manufacturer in Uji, Kyoto, with roots dating back to the Edo period. This 30g tin contains their most beloved koicha (thick tea) grade matcha, crafted from young tea leaves that provide a distinctive aroma known as "mirume ka." The matcha offers a rich, full-bodied flavor profile featuring notes of dark chocolate, toasted seeds, and roasted coffee, with an intense umami character and the characteristic covered tea fragrance. It's specifically designed for traditional tea ceremonies and is best prepared as a thick tea, though it can also be enjoyed as usucha (thin tea).

Name: Marukyu Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Yugen 20g Can
Short description: Yugen (又玄) is a high-quality ceremonial grade matcha powder produced by Marukyu Koyamaen, a historic tea grower from Uji, Kyoto with over 300 years of heritage. This 20g tin contains finely stone-ground green tea powder characterized by its refreshing grassy aroma and well-balanced flavor profile combining mild bitterness with umami. It's particularly suitable for preparing usucha (thin tea) and pairs excellently with both Japanese and Western confectionery. While not the highest grade in Marukyu Koyamaen's lineup, Yugen offers an accessible yet authentic matcha experience perfect for daily drinking and casual tea ceremonies.

Name: Maurkyu Koyamaen Matcha Powder, Yugen 40g Can
Short description: Yugen is a ceremonial grade matcha green tea powder produced by Marukyu Koyamaen, a prestigious tea manufacturer in Uji, Kyoto since 1704. This matcha offers a balanced flavor profile with a fresh, nutty taste, featuring subtle sweetness and a mild bitter aftertaste. It presents a refreshing grassy aroma with light umami notes. Best suited for making usucha (thin tea) and pairs well with both Japanese and Western confectionery. Ideal for daily matcha drinkers seeking a smooth, uncomplicated tea experience.

Name: Nestle Milk Tea Stick, 26 Packs
Short description: Nestle Fragrant Mellow Milk Tea is a convenient instant tea product featuring 26 individual stick sachets. Each stick contains a perfect blend of black tea extract and creamy milk powder that creates a smooth, aromatic milk tea when mixed with hot or cold water. The beverage offers a balanced sweetness with a rich tea fragrance and velvety texture. Perfect for those seeking a quick, consistent cup of Japanese-style milk tea at home or work. Each serving contains 32 calories and provides a comforting, mellow taste experience.

Name: Nissin MCT Oil HC 90g
Short description: Nissin MCT Oil HC 90g is a functional food product from Japan containing 100% medium-chain triglycerides (MCT). This clear, tasteless, and odorless oil is specifically designed for those with higher BMI to help reduce body fat, visceral fat, and waist circumference during daily activities. Each 2g serving contains 1.6g of MCTs (1.2g octanoic acid, 0.4g decanoic acid). The oil can be easily added to coffee, yogurt, smoothies, soups, or salads but should not be used for cooking. Perfect for those seeking weight management support or quick energy conversion.

Name: Kobayashi Eyebon W Vitamin Premium Eyewash 500ml
Short description: Kobayashi Eyebon W Vitamin Premium is a Japanese medicated eye wash solution with a distinctive pink color due to its vitamin B12 content. This preservative-free formula contains maximum allowable concentrations of three vitamins (B6, B12, and E) plus amino acids. The solution is specifically designed for contact lens users to wash away dirt, dust, and protein buildup after removing lenses. It helps relieve eye discomfort, fatigue, and irritation while promoting eye health through its anti-inflammatory, antihistamine, and corneal protective ingredients. The 500ml bottle comes with a specially designed upward-facing eye cup for thorough eye cleansing.

Name: Yanagiya Hair Tonic 240ml
Short description: Yanagiya Hair Tonic 240ml is a long-standing Japanese hair care product from a company established in 1615. This green-colored tonic contains natural plant extracts and medicinal ingredients like dipotassium glycyrrhizinate, vitamin E, and menthol. It's designed to prevent hair loss, promote hair growth, and maintain scalp health by improving blood circulation and preventing dandruff and itchiness. The formula features a refreshing mint sensation and comes in various versions including fragrance-free and citrus scent. Best suited for those concerned with hair thinning, scalp care, and maintaining healthy hair growth. The product has been a trusted brand in Japan since 1952.

Name: Naturie Hatomugi Skin Conditioner Limited Edition Free Bottle 500ml
Short description: This is the popular Naturie Hatomugi Skin Conditioner in its 500ml size, alongside a special Moomin collaboration bottle. This Japanese skincare product is a bestselling toner made with coix seed (hatomugi) extract, known for its moisturizing and skin-conditioning properties. The formula is fragrance-free, oil-free, alcohol-free, and hypoallergenic, making it suitable for all skin types. It can be used as a daily toner, face mask when applied with cotton pads, or as a body moisturizer. The product is particularly effective for those seeking hydration without heaviness, and helps with uneven skin tone and maintaining skin barrier function.

Name: KUNDAL Premium Shampoo Treatment Set, Cherry Blossom, 500ml
Short description: KUNDAL Honey & Macadamia Shampoo and Treatment Set is a premium Korean haircare duo featuring naturally-derived ingredients. The set includes a sulfate-free shampoo and protein treatment enriched with honey extract and macadamia oil. The formula contains 44 natural plant extracts and uses plant-derived surfactants to gently cleanse while maintaining scalp health. It's suitable for all hair types, including color-treated hair, and provides deep moisturizing and strengthening benefits. The products come in various signature fragrances created by professional perfumers, offering a spa-like experience. Best suited for those seeking natural ingredients and lasting hair fragrance.

Name: &Honey Winne the Pooh Pixie Moist Silky Set of 3 [Shampoo/Treatment/Conditioner]
Short description: This is a limited edition Winnie the Pooh themed hair care set from the Japanese brand &Honey Pixie. The Moist Silky line features a unique blend of three premium honey types (50% Manuka, 30% Italian citrus, 20% raw honey), combined with argan oil and hyaluronic acid. The set is specially formulated for fine, tangled, or damaged hair, providing intense hydration and silk-like smoothness. The formula contains over 90% moisturizing and protective ingredients, including cashmere silk proteins and keratin. It's particularly effective for those with frizzy or difficult-to-manage hair, leaving strands soft and manageable with a natural honey fragrance.

Name: &Honey Deep Moist Pine Amé Set [Shampoo/Treatment/4 Step Travel Kits]
Short description: This limited edition &Honey Deep Moist Pine Amé Set is a Japanese hair care collaboration between &Honey and Pine Amé candy brand, launching July 17, 2024. The set includes a 440ml shampoo, 445g treatment, and a travel kit with shampoo, treatment, hair oil, and body wash samples. Featuring three types of honey for intense moisture, it's designed for dry, frizzy hair. The products have a unique sweet-tangy "Pine Amé Honey" fragrance that combines pineapple candy and honey notes in retro-inspired packaging.

Name: Dove Body Wash Shea Butter & Vanilla Refill Pack
Short description: This Dove Body Wash Shea Butter & Vanilla Refill Pack is a premium moisturizing body cleanser featuring high-concentration shea butter and a vanilla fragrance. The formula contains instant-penetrating moisture milk technology and triple ceramides that maintain skin hydration long after bathing. With its rich, creamy lather and skin-nourishing ingredients, it's especially suitable for those seeking intensive moisture during dry winter months. The body wash creates a luxurious bathing experience with its warm vanilla and shea butter scent while protecting the skin's natural moisture barrier. Perfect for those with dry or sensitive skin looking for deep hydration.

Name: Diane Extra Night Repair Shampoo 450ml
Short description: Diane Extra Night Repair Shampoo is a Japanese haircare product designed for overnight deep repair of damaged hair. This silicone-free formula contains organic argan oil, night repair keratin, and silk amino acids to nourish and restore hair while you sleep. With a soothing midnight berry fragrance, it's ideal for those with dry, frizzy, or chemically-treated hair. The shampoo is part of a series that includes a matching treatment and hair mask, offering comprehensive care for stressed tresses.

Name: KUNDAL Hair Treatment, Baby Powder, 500ml
Short description: KUNDAL Honey & Macadamia Protein Treatment in Baby Powder scent is a Korean premium hair treatment that deeply moisturizes and nourishes damaged hair. The formula contains 4,000 ppm of honey and macadamia, along with 29 natural ingredients and 6 vegetable oils for comprehensive hair care. Its ultra-gentle formula features a signature baby powder fragrance that provides a soft, clean, and warm cotton scent that lasts throughout the day. Best suited for all hair types, particularly those seeking deep hydration and repair. The treatment leaves hair silky soft, manageable, and beautifully scented while helping to seal moisture in the hair cuticle.

Name: Diane Deep Night Moist Treatment 450g
Short description: The Diane Deep Night Moist Treatment is a premium Japanese hair treatment designed for deep moisturizing and repair. This 450ml bottle features a luxurious formula enriched with organic argan oil, five types of ceramides, and moisturizing keratin complex. The treatment effectively tackles frizz, repairs damage, and provides intense hydration while managing unruly waves. It leaves hair silky-smooth with a pleasant Moonlight Berry fragrance combining fresh fruits and gentle florals. This product is particularly suitable for those with dry, damaged, or thick hair that needs extra moisture and manageability. The distinctive emerald quilted bottle design adds an elegant touch to any bathroom counter.

Name: &Honey Gel Body Wash Winnie the Pooh Limited Edition
Short description: This is a limited edition Winnie the Pooh-themed body wash from the Japanese brand &Honey, featuring a cute hand-drawn Pooh design on the packaging. The body wash uses a special "Honey Gel Formula" that combines propolis extract, honey-derived cleansing ingredients, and raw honey for gentle cleansing while maintaining skin moisture. It has a unique "Märchen Honey" fragrance that blends floral notes with honey sweetness. The product is particularly suitable for those seeking a moisturizing body wash that leaves skin soft and hydrated while enjoying a whimsical Disney-themed bath experience.

Name: Kikumasamune High Moisture Sake Skincare Lotion 500ml
Short description: Kikumasamune High Moist Sake Lotion is a Japanese hydrating toner made by a traditional sake brewery. This 500ml pink-bottled product contains sake (rice ferment filtrate), ceramides, amino acids, arbutin, and placenta extract. The lightweight, slightly viscous formula provides deep hydration and brightening effects while helping improve skin texture. It features a mild sake scent that dissipates quickly after application. Best suited for those seeking intense moisture, dealing with dryness, or wanting to achieve brighter skin. Can be used on both face and body, and works particularly well as a hydrating mask when applied with cotton pads.

Name: Neo Vita White C Plus 240 Tablets
Short description: Neo Vita White C Plus is a Type 3 over-the-counter medicine from Kokando Pharmaceutical in Japan, designed to address skin pigmentation concerns like freckles, spots, and sunburn-induced discoloration. Each daily dose (6 tablets) contains 1000mg Vitamin C, 240mg L-cysteine, 50mg Vitamin E, and B-complex vitamins. The formula works by inhibiting melanin production while promoting collagen synthesis and skin metabolism. The combination of L-cysteine activates skin metabolism, Vitamin E improves blood circulation, and B vitamins regulate sebaceous gland function. Best suited for adults seeking internal support for skin brightening and those needing vitamin C supplementation during physical fatigue, pregnancy, or recovery periods.

Name: Shiseido Pure White 240 Tablets
Short description: Shiseido Pure White is a premium Japanese whitening supplement designed to promote skin radiance and clarity. Each bottle contains 240 tablets for a 30-day supply, with a recommended dosage of 8 tablets daily. The formula features carefully selected oriental beauty ingredients, including goji berry extract, palm oil, lychee seed extract, pearl barley, and chrysanthemum extract, plus 500mg of Vitamin C and Vitamin E. This supplement is particularly beneficial for those frequently exposed to UV rays, individuals seeking improved skin transparency, and those wanting to maintain youthful-looking skin. The tablets help prevent freckles and maintain healthy, translucent skin while supporting overall skin beauty from within.

Name: Lucido-L Argan Rich Oil Hair Treatment Water 170ml
Short description: This Lucido-L Argan Rich Oil Hair Treatment Water is a Japanese leave-in hair treatment spray that combines argan oil in a lightweight water-based formula. The product features UV protection and heat protection properties, making it ideal for heat styling. It instantly moisturizes hair while providing a non-greasy, smooth finish. The formula is designed to restore shine to dull and frizzy hair while keeping it tangle-free. With its feather-light texture and light floral fragrance, this treatment is best suited for those seeking manageable, shiny hair without heavy residue. It can be used on both damp or dry hair for styling and maintenance.

Name: SHISEIDO SPF50+ PA+++ Sun Care Perfect UV Protection S 50ml
Short description: The sunscreen provides high protection with SPF 50+ PA++++ rating and becomes more effective when exposed to water or perspiration for 15 minutes through its WetForce technology. While it may leave a slight white cast due to its mineral-based formulation, this is a normal characteristic of physical sunscreens that are generally considered safer for children's sensitive skin \n \n

Name: Melano CC Whitening Gel 100g
Short description: Melano CC Whitening Gel is a Japanese quasi-drug moisturizing gel designed to combat hyperpigmentation and acne. The key active ingredients include Vitamin C derivative (L-Ascorbic Acid 2-Glucoside) to suppress melanin production, Vitamin E derivative for blood circulation, and Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate for anti-inflammation. This lightweight gel features a refreshing citrus scent and can be used as a moisturizer after toner or essence. It's particularly effective for those concerned with dark spots, freckles, and post-acne marks. The gel absorbs quickly without leaving sticky residue and can be used on both face and body, especially after sun exposure.

Name: White Conc Whitening Body Pack, 100g
Short description: White Conc Whitening Body Pack CⅡ is a Japanese medicated body whitening treatment mask with a grapefruit scent. This in-shower pack contains placenta extract, dual collagen, triple hyaluronic acid, and vitamin C for intensive brightening and moisturizing effects. Simply apply to wet skin during bathing and rinse off. It's particularly effective for targeting dark areas like elbows, knees, underarms, and décolletage. The pack helps prevent melanin production, reduces dark spots, and provides deep hydration while improving skin texture. Best suited for those looking to achieve brighter, more even-toned body skin with minimal effort.

Name: Senka Perfect Whip Cleansing Foam, White Clay, BT21 Collaboration, 120g
Short description: This is a special BT21 collaboration edition of SENKA Perfect Whip White Clay facial cleanser from Japan. The 120g foam cleanser features white clay and activated charcoal to effectively remove stubborn blackheads, dead skin cells, and pore-clogging impurities. Its unique micro beauty foam technology provides gentle yet thorough cleansing while maintaining skin moisture. The product is especially suitable for those concerned with visible pores, blackheads, and dull skin who want a deep cleansing experience without drying out their skin.

Name: ELIXIR Enriched Wrinkle White Cream 15g
Short description: The ELIXIR Enriched Wrinkle White Cream is a Japanese quasi-drug skincare product by Shiseido designed for both wrinkle improvement and skin brightening. This dual-action cream contains pure retinol that boosts hyaluronic acid production and improves skin elasticity, while m-tranexamic acid works to prevent dark spots and freckles. With a pleasant aqua floral scent, the cream is specifically formulated for targeted application around the eyes, mouth, and other areas prone to wrinkles. Best suited for those seeking anti-aging and brightening benefits in one product, it should be applied as the final step in skincare routines, morning and night, using a pearl-sized amount.

Name: &Honey Tinkerbell Melty Moist Repair Hair Oil
Short description: The &Honey Tinkerbell Melty Moist Repair Hair Oil is a Japanese hair treatment oil designed for wavy and curly hair types. This product features a unique formula with 14% moisture content and contains a blend of three types of honey (Manuka, acacia, and raw honey), royal jelly extract, and argan oil. The lightweight oil effectively smooths away frizz and dryness while providing intense hydration without feeling heavy. It has a delicate shower rose honey scent enhanced with Bulgarian damask rose water. Best suited for those with dry, damaged, or unruly hair seeking moisture and manageability. The product comes in a charming Tinkerbell-themed packaging as part of a limited Disney collaboration.

Name: Nail Nail Support Na 6ml
Short description: The BCL Nail Support Na is a Japanese nail strengthening treatment that functions as both a base and top coat. This quick-drying formula contains diamond powder and five moisturizing ingredients to create a protective barrier that reinforces weak, brittle, or splitting nails. The clear coating provides a glossy finish while preventing breakage and peeling. Key features include a reinforcing polymer coating, crystal polymers for shine, and moisturizing ingredients like silk extract and panthenol. It's particularly beneficial for those with weak nails, those taking a break from gel manicures, or anyone looking to grow stronger, healthier natural nails.

Name: Dove Body Scrub Sakura & Musk Scent 298g
Short description: This Dove Body Scrub in Sakura & Musk scent is a creamy-textured exfoliating scrub that gently removes dead skin cells while deeply moisturizing. The whipped cream-like texture contains Dove's signature moisturizing formula with 1/4 moisturizing cream that penetrates deep into the skin layers. The scrub features a delicate blend of cherry blossom and musk fragrance, creating a relaxing bathing experience. Winner of @cosme magazine's 2024 award, this 298g scrub is particularly suitable for those seeking gentle exfoliation and hydration, especially on rough areas like elbows and heels. Recommended for use twice weekly on damp skin.

Name: Dove Body Scrub Osmanthus Scent 298g
Short description: This limited edition Dove Body Scrub features a sweet osmanthus (kinmokusei) fragrance, popular during Japanese autumn. The product has a whipped cream-like texture that gently exfoliates with silica beads while providing deep moisturization through its milk-based formula. The creamy scrub contains vitamin E derivatives and moisturizing ingredients that penetrate deep into the skin's surface layers. Best suited for those seeking gentle exfoliation with intense hydration, it can be used on the entire body except face. The osmanthus scent offers a soothing, aromatic bathing experience typical of Japanese seasonal skincare products.

Name: Botanist Shampoo, Scalp Cleanse 460ml
Short description: Botanist Shampoo Deep Cleanse is a premium Japanese hair care product that focuses on scalp health and natural ingredients. This silicone-free formula features a refreshing lime and green leaf fragrance, containing 88% naturally-derived ingredients including white birch extract, rosemary leaf extract, and nanoized plant-based components. The shampoo effectively cleanses while maintaining moisture balance, making it ideal for those seeking a deep clean without stripping the scalp. It's particularly suitable for people with oily scalps or those wanting a thorough yet gentle cleanse. The eco-friendly packaging reflects the brand's commitment to sustainability.

Name: Matsukiyo Body Milky Rose Scent 400ml
Short description: This Matsukiyo Body Milk is a gentle, weakly acidic body moisturizer with a rose fragrance. The 400ml lotion contains high-moisture ingredients including petroleum jelly, shea butter, honey, and peach leaf extract. It effectively hydrates and protects skin from dryness while maintaining skin's natural pH balance. The lightweight, non-sticky formula is suitable for daily use and gentle enough for sensitive skin. Its pleasant rose scent and moisturizing properties make it ideal for those seeking basic yet effective body care.

Name: Propolinse Mouthwash, Sakura Chiikawa Edition
Short description: This is a limited-edition Propolinse mouthwash featuring Chiikawa character designs in a pink sakura (cherry blossom) variant. It's a unique Japanese oral care product that visibly binds and removes protein-based mouth debris. The alcohol-free formula has a gentle, sweet cherry blossom flavor, making it suitable for children and those with sensitive mouths. This collaboration product combines the popular Chiikawa characters with Propolinse's effective cleaning technology, containing natural ingredients like propolis extract and green tea for dental hygiene and breath freshening.

Name: &Honey Deep Moist Treatment Refill 350g
Short description: The &Honey Deep Moist Treatment 2.0 Refill is a premium Japanese hair treatment designed for dry and damaged hair. This deep conditioning treatment features a unique blend of three organic honeys: 50% Manuka (New Zealand), 30% Acacia (Hungary), and 20% raw Japanese honey. Over 90% of its formula consists of moisturizing and protective ingredients, including argan oil, royal jelly, propolis, hyaluronic acid, and silk proteins. The product boasts a 14% moisture level, higher than traditional treatments, and comes with a soothing lavender honey scent. It's especially effective for those seeking intense hydration and repair for damaged, frizzy, or unmanageable hair.

Name: &Honey Melty Moist Repair Treatment Refill 350g
Short description: This is a premium Japanese hair treatment refill pack from the &Honey Melty line, specifically designed for frizzy and unruly hair. The formula contains three types of honey and maintains 14% moisture content in hair, with over 90% of ingredients dedicated to moisturizing and protective components. It features a sweet rose honey fragrance and is particularly effective for those with wavy, curly, or damaged hair. The treatment helps smooth out frizz while providing deep nourishment through natural ingredients like honey, argan oil, propolis, keratin, and royal jelly, leaving hair soft and manageable with a healthy shine.

Name: &Honey Melty Moist Repair Shampoo Refill 350ml
Short description: The &Honey Melty Moist Repair Shampoo is a Japanese moisturizing shampoo featuring a unique blend of three honey types (Manuka, Acacia, and Raw honey) with Bulgarian rose water. This sulfate-free formula contains over 90% moisturizing and protective ingredients, including argan oil, royal jelly, and propolis. Designed specifically for wavy, frizzy, and dehydrated hair types, it helps maintain 14% moisture content in hair while controlling frizz and reducing unruly texture. The shampoo has a distinctive pure rose honey fragrance. Best suited for those with dry, damaged hair seeking moisture and frizz control, though those with oily scalps may find it too moisturizing for frequent use.

Name: Premium Aroma, Grace Beaute, Room Fragrance 400ml
Short description: Premium Aroma Room Fragrance Grace Beaute is a sophisticated air freshener and deodorizer designed for living spaces and entryways. The fragrance combines elegant peony and lily of the valley notes wrapped in deep amber, creating a luxurious perfume-quality scent. It features nano-powder technology that quickly absorbs and eliminates unpleasant odors. The 400ml bottle offers adjustable fragrance intensity and lasts 2-3 months depending on usage conditions. This premium room freshener is ideal for those seeking an elegant, long-lasting fragrance solution that both deodorizes and adds a refined ambiance to their living space.

Name: Premium Aroma, Osmanthus Scent, Room Fragrance 400ml
Short description: This is a Premium Aroma room deodorizer and air freshener from ST featuring an Osmanthus (Kinmokusei) fragrance. The product combines delicate osmanthus notes with fresh citrus and gentle jasmine to create a sophisticated perfume-like scent. It contains nano-powder technology for powerful odor absorption and deodorizing effects. The 400ml bottle provides 2-3 months of fragrance, with adjustable intensity. Ideal for entrances, living rooms, and bedrooms where a refined, long-lasting aroma is desired.

Name: Premium Aroma For Closet, Hanging Type, Osmanthus Scent 1 piece
Short description: The Premium Aroma is a high-end closet freshener and moth repellent from the Japanese brand Mushuda by ST Corporation. This specialized wardrobe care product offers one year of protection against moths and mold while infusing closets with elegant fragrances developed by professional perfumers. The product comes in a set of three hanging sachets that are ideal for closets up to 800L per sachet. The version shown features the Kinmokusei (Osmanthus) fragrance, though other scents like Urban Romance and Grace Beauté are available. Perfect for those seeking both clothing protection and sophisticated closet fragrance in a single solution.

Name: Dove Sakura & Musk Beauty Moisture Set, Glossy Foaming Body Wash 540ml + Body Scrub 298g
Short description: This limited edition Dove set combines a sakura-scented body wash and a creamy body scrub for a luxurious Japanese-inspired bathing experience. The body wash features Japanese sakura (cherry blossom) and rice water essence for deep moisturizing, while the creamy scrub contains gentle exfoliating particles and moisturizing milk that helps remove dead skin cells without friction. The scrub's unique whipped cream-like texture spreads smoothly on wet skin. Both products feature an enchanting blend of sakura and musk fragrance, making them ideal for those seeking soft, plump skin with a subtle floral scent. Best suited for those wanting gentle exfoliation with intense moisture.

Name: Botanist Body Soap Refill, Deep Moist 425ml
Short description: This is a refill pack of Botanist's Deep Moist Body Soap, a premium Japanese body cleanser designed for those with particularly dry skin. The formula features plant-derived ingredients including Sugar Squalane for skin conditioning, olive-based cleansing agents, and Botanical Butter Milk (a blend of shea butter, coconut oil, and almond oil) for intense moisture retention. The body soap creates a rich, creamy lather and leaves skin feeling supple and hydrated. It's fragrant with refreshing notes of water lily and raspberry, making it perfect for those seeking a moisturizing, gentle cleanser with a delicate scent. The product is free from synthetic colorants, parabens, sulfates, and alcohol.

Name: Quality 1st Super Retinol100 7 Sheets
Short description: Quality 1st Super Retinol 100 is a Japanese nighttime sheet mask designed for intensive anti-aging care. Each package contains 7 sheets featuring the highest concentration of retinol in the series. The mask utilizes unique capsule penetration technology to deliver active ingredients deep into the skin, targeting fine lines, texture, and wrinkles while enhancing firmness and elasticity. Made in Japan, it's free from preservatives, alcohol, synthetic colorants, fragrances, and mineral oils. The mask is best suited for those concerned with aging signs and seeking intensive overnight skin rejuvenation. Application takes just 3-5 minutes, making it convenient for regular use.

Name: Quality 1st Derma Laser Super Exosome100 Mask 7 Sheets
Short description: Quality 1st Derma Laser Super Exosome 100 Mask is a premium Japanese sheet mask featuring highly concentrated exosomes derived from human adipose mesenchymal cells. This innovative mask delivers intensive skin firming and restoration benefits in just 3 minutes. The formula combines five types of vitamin C and niacinamide with exosomes, utilizing three unique penetration technologies for optimal ingredient delivery. The mask uses long-fiber cotton material for superior adhesion and is free from preservatives, alcohol, artificial colors, fragrances, and mineral oils. Best suited for those seeking anti-aging benefits and improved skin elasticity.

Name: LuLuLun Hydra EX Mask Exosome Box 30 Sheets
Short description: LuLuLun Hydra EX Mask is a Japanese daily anti-aging sheet mask that combines cutting-edge regenerative technology with human adipose-derived mesenchymal cell exosomes and glutathione. The ultra-soft, thick melty-feel sheet delivers deep hydration while targeting signs of aging like sagging, loss of firmness, and dullness. Enriched with EGF, hyaluronic acid, ceramides, and collagen, this mask is ideal for mature skin seeking improved elasticity, radiance, and moisture. Each box contains 28 individually wrapped masks for daily use.

Name: KOSÉ Clear Turn Pores Care Mask Box, 30 Sheets
Short description: Kose Clear Turn Tigeraid CICA Repair Mask is a Japanese sheet mask pack containing 30 sheets with tweezers for hygienic application. The mask features Centella Asiatica (CICA) extract and vitamin blend to provide intensive moisture and repair for stressed skin. The formula contains three types of Centella Asiatica extracts, niacinamide, panthenol, vitamin B6, and vitamin C derivative. Free from alcohol, parabens, silicones, mineral oils, and fragrances, this mask is ideal for those with sensitive or rough skin texture. Best used as part of a morning skincare routine, each mask should be left on for 5-15 minutes for optimal results.

Name: Tsubaki Shampoo Refill, Premium Volume & Repair, 600ml
Short description: This is a refill pack of Shiseido's Tsubaki Premium Volume & Repair Shampoo, a Japanese hair care product featuring camellia (tsubaki) oil. The shampoo is specifically formulated for fine, soft hair that needs volume and repair. It penetrates deep into the hair structure, providing bounce and volume from the roots while repairing damage. With its floral camellia fragrance, the shampoo delivers visible results from the first use, making hair fuller, shinier, and more manageable. Best suited for those with limp, damaged, or lifeless hair seeking volume and restoration.

Name: Tsubaki Conditioner Refill, Premium Volume & Repair, 600ml
Short description: This is a premium hair conditioner refill from Shiseido's Tsubaki line, specifically the Premium Volume & Repair variant. The conditioner features a unique formula with tsubaki (camellia) oil, royal jelly extract, and soybean extracts to repair damaged hair while adding volume. It's particularly effective for hair weakened by chemical treatments and heat styling, providing deep nourishment without weighing hair down. The product promises to restore elasticity and shine while supporting healthy roots with a pleasant floral-fruity fragrance. Best suited for those with fine, limp, or damaged hair seeking volume and repair.

Name: Nivea Rich Care & Color Bordeaux
Short description: The NIVEA Rich Care & Color Lip in Bordeaux is a tinted lip balm that combines skincare and color. This Japanese product features SPF20/PA++ protection and contains three nourishing oils - macadamia, avocado, and jojoba. The Bordeaux shade offers a sheer, wine-tinted color similar to Clinique's Black Honey, making it suitable for achieving a natural, sophisticated look. The formula is fragrance-free and provides a luxurious, melting texture that moisturizes while adding a glossy finish. It's particularly well-suited for those seeking daily lip care with a subtle tint and UV protection.

Name: Nivea Rich Care & Color, Smoky Rose
Short description: The NIVEA Rich Care & Color Lip in Smoky Rose is a tinted lip balm that combines skincare and color. This Japanese product features a moisturizing formula with three beauty oils (macademia nut, avocado, and jojoba) for a melting, smooth application. It provides a transparent rosy tint with a glossy finish while offering UV protection (SPF20 PA++). The fragrance-free formula is particularly suitable for those seeking a natural-looking lip color with care benefits. Perfect for daily wear, especially for those with dry lips who want a subtle, elegant rose tint while maintaining lip health.

Name: Bifesta Lip Scrub Balm
Short description: Bifesta Lip Scrub Balm is a Japanese lip care product by Mandom Corporation that combines a sugar scrub with a melting balm texture. This wash-off treatment effectively removes lip roughness, dullness from accumulated dirt, and makeup residue while keeping lips moisturized. The formula features five natural moisturizing ingredients including orange oil, macadamia nut oil, shea butter, mango butter, and jojoba oil. Free from preservatives, alcohol, synthetic fragrances, and colorants, this gentle scrub is ideal for those seeking smoother, more supple lips and can also be used for lip massage to improve circulation.

Name: Biore UV AQUA Rich Aqua Protect Mist 50+++
Short description: The Biore UV Aqua Rich Aqua Protect Mist is a non-aerosol sunscreen spray with SPF50+ PA++++ protection. This Japanese product features a fine, water-like mist that quickly transforms into a gel-like texture upon contact with skin, providing even coverage without white cast. It's super waterproof (80-minute water resistance), contains moisturizing squalane, and can be used on face, body, and hair. Perfect for on-the-go UV protection, it's non-sticky, quick-drying, and can be applied over makeup. The spray works even when held upside down and has a fresh citrus scent.

Name: &Honey Sakura Pixie Moist Silky Hair Oil
Short description: This is &Honey Sakura Pixie Moist Silky Hair Oil, a Japanese hair treatment oil featuring a sweet Yaesakura (double-cherry blossom) honey fragrance. The formula contains over 90% moisturizing and protective ingredients, including honey, golden silk, and cashmere silk components. Specifically designed for dry, tangled, and flyaway hair, this oil provides intense hydration while making hair more manageable and silky smooth. It's particularly suitable for those struggling with frizz and difficult-to-manage hair.

Name: &Honey Pixie Sabon Silky Moist Hair Oil
Short description: The &honey Pixie Sabon Moist Silky Hair Oil is a Japanese hair treatment product designed to combat frizz and tangled hair. The formula contains over 90% moisturizing ingredients, including three types of honey and silk proteins. It features a lightweight, non-greasy texture that helps manage unruly and fine hair while providing deep hydration. The product is particularly effective for those with dry, tangled, or fine hair types, and offers a refreshing emerald soap-honey fragrance.

Name: Momori Hair Keeping Brush, Hair Mascara
Short description: The Momori Hair Keep Brush is a 10ml mascara-type hair styling product from Japanese brand Dariya. This innovative hair fixer features a brush applicator designed for quick touch-ups of flyaways, bangs, and baby hairs. Infused with peach extract and peach oil, it provides a natural-looking finish without stickiness or shine while moisturizing the hair. The product has a sweet peach fruity fleur fragrance and comes in a portable mascara-style packaging perfect for on-the-go styling. Ideal for those seeking easy control of unruly hair with a natural look.

Name: FIANCEE Body Mist Pure Shampoo
Short description: FIANCEE Body Mist Pure Shampoo is a Japanese fragrance mist that captures the essence of freshly washed hair and the clean feeling after a bath. The 50ml glass bottle contains a gentle, sweet, and refreshing scent that develops in layers: starting with green apple and lemon top notes, followed by subtle floral middle notes, and finishing with a clean, sophisticated base note. Perfect for fragrance beginners and those who prefer subtle scents, it's ideal for daily use in professional or academic settings. While the scent is universally appealing to all genders, it has a relatively short duration of a few hours.

Name: LUCIDO-L Multi-Arrange Hair Stick, Extra Hard
Short description: The LUCIDO-L Multi-Arrange Hair Stick (Extra Hard) is a convenient styling stick designed for precise hair control. This non-sticky, elliptical-shaped wax stick effectively tames flyaway hair, holds updos, and manages bangs with a strong yet natural-looking hold. It features a moisture shield formula, UV protection, and shea butter for hair care. The product is ideal for those seeking quick touch-ups without messy hands, especially suitable for office workers and people on-the-go. It comes with a pleasant stylish green fragrance and is particularly effective for stubborn hair and humid conditions.

Name: Diane Dry Shampoo Fresh Citrus & Pear Scent 95g
Short description: Diane Perfect Beauty Dry Shampoo is a Japanese aerosol hair refresher that instantly absorbs excess oil and sweat without leaving white residue. The formula contains micro-powder, keratin, ceramide, and jojoba oil to control sebum while maintaining hair's moisture and smoothness. With a refreshing citrus and pear fragrance, it's perfect for post-workout, midday touch-ups, or when traditional washing isn't possible. Best suited for those with oily scalp or who need quick hair revival between washes. The spray can be used for both styling finish and pre-brushing treatment.

Name: &Honey Cleansing Balm Black
Short description: The &honey Cleansing Balm Black is a Japanese skincare product specifically designed for deep pore cleansing and sebum control. This black-colored balm features key ingredients like black honey, activated charcoal, and black mud to effectively remove blackheads, excess sebum, and stubborn makeup. With over 90% moisturizing ingredients, including eight types of black serum components, it cleanses without drying the skin. The balm has a refreshing citrus-honey scent and is particularly suitable for those with oily skin or persistent blackhead concerns.

Name: &Honey Sakura Cleansing Balm Clear
Short description: The &Honey Sakura Cleansing Balm Clear is a limited edition cleansing balm from Japan featuring a cherry blossom (sakura) design and fragrance. This 5-in-1 product functions as a makeup remover, exfoliator, cleanser, massager, and moisturizer. Formulated with honey and papain enzymes, it effectively removes makeup while caring for pores and sebum. The balm transforms from a solid to oil texture, providing a refreshing cleanse that leaves skin clear and hydrated. Best suited for those seeking thorough yet gentle makeup removal with pore care benefits.

Name: Canmake Munyutto Highlighter 04
Short description: The CANMAKE Munyutto Highlighter in 04 Blue Topaz is a unique cream highlighter with a squishy, cookie dough-like texture that transforms into a silky finish upon application. This Japanese beauty product features silver and blue-polarizing pearls that create a delicate, translucent glow. Water, sweat, and sebum-resistant, it provides a dewy sheen without creasing over foundation. Particularly suited for those seeking a cool-toned, ethereal highlight that enhances skin's transparency, making it especially popular among cool-toned skin types.

Name: Moton Silk Hair Oil, Flower Garden, 100ml
Short description: MOTON Silk Hair Oil in Flower Garden is a Korean hair treatment that combines luxury fragrance with hair care benefits. This lightweight oil features a sophisticated floral scent profile with notes of mandarin, rose, peony, and musk. The formula contains multiple plant proteins and amino acids to protect hair from heat damage while providing moisture and shine. Best suited for those who want a premium hair oil that doubles as a subtle perfume, leaving hair silky smooth with an elegant, long-lasting fragrance.

Name: FIANCEE Gel Fragrance Pure Shampoo
Short description: FIANCEE Gel Fragrance Pure Shampoo is a Japanese compact gel-based fragrance that captures the essence of freshly washed hair. The gel formula comes in a lip gloss-like applicator, making it spill-proof and perfect for on-the-go touch-ups. It features a delicate, clean scent reminiscent of post-shower freshness, combining notes of lemon, green apple, jasmine, muguet, and musk. Ideal for those who prefer subtle fragrances or environments where strong perfumes are inappropriate, this portable fragrance is particularly popular among students and office workers.

Name: Mentholatum Hand Veil, Premium Rich Nail Cream
Short description: Mentholatum Hand Veil Premium Rich Nail Cream is a Japanese intensive nail repair cream by ROHTO Pharmaceutical. This concentrated formula targets all three layers of the nail to repair damage from gel nails and frequent polish removal. Enriched with ceramides, squalane, hyaluronic acid, and blueberry leaf extract, it strengthens weak nails while preventing breakage and delamination. Best suited for those with brittle, dry, or damaged nails, particularly after frequent gel nail applications or excessive use of nail polish remover.

Name: Moton Hair & Body Mist, Nude Calm, 80ml
Short description: MOTON Hair & Body Mist in Nude Calm is a luxurious Korean fragrance mist designed for both hair and body use. The 80ml spray features a sophisticated blend of rose and fruity notes balanced with wood and green undertones, creating an elegant, transparent scent profile. Enriched with beauty ingredients including hyaluronic acid and natural oils, this versatile mist provides a gentle yet long-lasting fragrance that's perfect for daily use. Ideal for those seeking a subtle, high-end alternative to traditional perfumes.

Name: Sarasati Lingerie Detergent, For Menstrual Blood Scent, Soap Scent 120ml
Short description: Sarasati Lingerie Detergent is a specialized Japanese laundry product designed for delicate underwear care, particularly for removing menstrual blood stains, discharge, and other blood-related stains. This gentle, soap-scented detergent features a unique 20-minute soak formula that effectively removes even set-in stains without damaging delicate fabrics. Perfect for cotton, linen, and synthetic materials, it's damage-free and ideal for period panties maintenance. The 120ml bottle comes with measurement markings for precise usage, though it's not suitable for silk, wool, cupro, or rayon materials.

Name: KUNDAL Protein Bonding Hair Mist Serum, Violet Muguet, 150ml
Short description: KUNDAL Protein Bonding Hair Mist Serum is a dual-layer hair treatment combining moisture essence and oil serum in a convenient spray format. This vegan formula features protein bonding technology and hydro-boosting ingredients to repair damaged hair, enhance shine, and provide heat protection up to 230°C. The lightweight mist can be used on wet or dry hair and features a sophisticated Violet Muguet fragrance blending lily of the valley with violet herbs. Ideal for those seeking to restore damaged, dry hair while maintaining a lightweight, non-greasy finish.

Name: Moist Diane Body Milk White Floral Scent 250ml
Short description: Moist Diane Body Milk White Floral is a lightweight, non-greasy body moisturizer designed for daily use. This Japanese body milk features a delicate white floral fragrance and brightening properties to help achieve radiant skin. Particularly effective for décolleté and neck areas, it helps protect against UV damage and dryness while maintaining long-lasting hydration. The formula absorbs quickly with a non-sticky finish, making it ideal for summer use and those who prefer lightweight moisturizers.

Name: Tsubaki Camellia Oil 100% 40ml
Short description: Oshima Tsubaki is a 100% pure camellia oil extracted from seeds of Japanese Camellia flowers grown on Izu Oshima island. This fragrance-free, colorant-free natural oil has been a trusted Japanese beauty staple since 1927. The versatile multi-purpose oil is ideal for hair, scalp, and skin care. It excels at protecting hair from heat and UV damage, preventing split ends, moisturizing dry scalp, and providing anti-aging skincare benefits through its rich oleic acid content. Best suited for those seeking a lightweight, non-greasy natural moisturizing treatment.

Name: Ichikami Hair Treatment Serum, Wagusa Essence 100ml
Short description: This Kracie Ichikami Moisture Waso Hair Treatment Serum is a leave-in treatment designed for damaged hair care. The formula features Japanese botanical extracts including rice bran, cherry blossom leaf, and evening primrose oil. It deeply moisturizes hair from the core, controls frizz, and provides UV protection while leaving hair silky smooth and manageable. The lightweight, non-sticky essence has a delicate wild cherry blossom fragrance. Best suited for those with dry, damaged hair seeking a Japanese-style hair treatment that provides both repair and prevention.

Name: Body Fantasie Body Mist, Wedding Day Bouquet Scent 50ml
Short description: Body Fantasies Body Spray Wedding Day Bouquet Scent is a light floral fragrance mist designed for everyday use. This delicate scent features a layered composition starting with apple blossom, clementine, and raspberry top notes, followed by peony, freesia, and rose middle notes, and finishing with creamy musk, amber, and sandalwood base notes. The fragrance creates a clean, sophisticated aura reminiscent of a bridal bouquet. Perfect for those seeking a subtle, feminine scent that's not overpowering, it's ideal for daily wear or special occasions. While the scent doesn't last as long as traditional perfumes, its portable size makes it convenient for touch-ups throughout the day.

Name: KUNDAL Ultra Serum, Perfume Scent, 100ml
Short description: KUNDAL Ultra Hair Serum is a lightweight, non-greasy hair treatment serum featuring macadamia nut oil and 15 other plant-derived oils. The formula is designed to repair damaged hair, reduce breakage, enhance elasticity, and provide hydration without leaving residue. Available in multiple fragrances including Cherry Blossom, White Musk, Amber Vanilla, Pink Grapefruit, and English Rose. Best suited for all hair types, including color-treated hair, offering protection against heat styling and environmental damage while leaving hair silky smooth and manageable.

Name: KUNDAL Night Repair Hair Lotion, Into The Dream Scent, 100ml
Short description: KUNDAL Night Repair Hair Lotion is a Korean leave-in hair treatment designed for overnight use. This purple-bottled formula features a Night Wrapping System with plant-based collagen that moisturizes and coats hair while you sleep. The product has a distinctive oriental musk fragrance combining citrus and spicy notes with white floral undertones. It's particularly beneficial for those with dry, damaged hair, providing 24-hour volume maintenance and deep nourishment. Best suited for people seeking overnight hair repair without washing in the morning.

Name: Diane Deep Night Moist Treatment Refill 660ml
Short description: Diane Deep Night Moist Treatment Refill is a Japanese hair treatment refill pack designed for overnight hair repair and moisturizing. This sulfate-free formula features organic argan oil, moist keratin, and vitamin E capsules to deeply nourish damaged and unruly hair while you sleep. The product is especially effective for dry, thick, and frizzy hair types, leaving strands smooth and manageable. It has a pleasant moonlight berry fragrance combining fruity and floral notes. Best suited for those seeking intensive overnight moisture and frizz control.

Name: KUNDAL Protein Bonding No Wash Treatment 130ml
Short description: KUNDAL Protein Bonding No Wash Treatment is a leave-in hair treatment designed for damaged and dry hair. The formula features Double Care Bonding Technology with plant proteins and algae extracts that penetrate deep into hair cuticles to strengthen and repair. Enhanced with six types of hyaluronic acid and a Pink Glam complex (rose, tulip, and hibiscus extracts), it provides intense moisture and shine. This non-rinse treatment works particularly well for brittle, frizzy hair and can be applied to both wet or dry hair. The product comes in different scents, with the pictured version being Violet Muguet, offering a powdery floral fragrance.

Name: FLAIR Fabric Softener Savon de Savon Scent 940ml
Short description: Kao's FLAIR Fabric Softener in Savon de Savon scent is a premium Japanese laundry softener featuring a sophisticated blend of 50 fragrances. The scent combines transparent jasmine and soft musk notes that last up to 12 hours, even after sweating. This fabric softener not only provides a long-lasting fresh fragrance but also offers antibacterial properties, prevents static and wrinkles, and leaves clothes exceptionally soft. The refill pouch format makes it eco-friendly and convenient for regular use.

Name: FLAIR Fabric Softener Floral Sweet Scent 940ml
Short description: Kao's FLAIR Fabric Softener in Floral Sweet scent is a premium Japanese laundry softener featuring their Diamond Aroma technology. This softener combines elegant floral notes with fresh peach and warm vanilla undertones. It provides 12-hour fragrance that activates with body heat and moisture, while offering antibacterial and anti-static properties. The formula keeps clothes soft, wrinkle-free, and pleasantly scented. Perfect for those who prefer a subtle yet sophisticated floral fragrance that doesn't overwhelm.

Name: &Honey Pixie Sabon Moist Silky Shampoo Treatment Set
Short description: The &Honey Pixie Sabon Moist Silky Shampoo and Treatment Set is a premium Japanese hair care duo specially formulated for dry, tangled, and fine hair. The products contain a luxurious blend of honey, royal jelly, propolis, hyaluronic acid, and argan oil, with over 90% of the formula consisting of moisturizing and protective ingredients. Enhanced with cashmere silk components, it effectively reduces tangles and improves manageability. The shampoo features a refreshing emerald sabon honey scent, while the treatment has a luminous floral honey fragrance. This set is particularly beneficial for those with dry, frizzy, or difficult-to-manage hair, promising silky-smooth results from root to tip.

Name: Kundal Protein Bonding for Damage Hair Shampoo Treatment Set 500ml + 250ml
Short description: KUNDAL Protein Bonding Damage Care Set combines a 500ml shampoo and 250ml treatment specifically designed for dry, damaged hair. The formula features Double Care Bonding Technology that enhances protein bonding within hair strands while providing deep hydration. Enriched with Pink Glam Complex (Provence Rose, Tulip, and Hibiscus extracts) and 8 types of Hyaluronic Acid, it repairs and strengthens hair from within. Best suited for those with chemically treated, heat-damaged, or protein-deficient hair seeking salon-level restoration and shine.

Name: YOLU Relax Night Repair Set of 3 [Shampoo/Treatment/Bath Tablets]
Short description: YOLU Relax Night Repair Set is a Japanese nighttime hair and bath care system featuring a shampoo (475ml), treatment (475g), and bath tablets (40g x 2). The set is designed for those with frizzy or unruly hair, working overnight to repair and smooth hair while you sleep. Formulated with keratin, silk tree bark extract, and mallow flower extract, it's silicone and paraben-free. The products feature a calming pear and geranium fragrance to promote relaxation. The bath tablets dissolve to create a carbonated bath experience with moisturizing properties.

Name: &Honey Melty Moist Repair Set of 3 Winne the Pooh Edition [Shampoo/Treatment/Hair Oil]
Short description: This is a limited edition Winnie the Pooh collaboration with &Honey, featuring their Melty Moist Repair hair care line. The set includes shampoo (440ml), treatment (445ml), and hair oil (100ml) in specially designed packaging featuring Pooh and Piglet. The formula contains three types of honey and hyaluronic acid for intense moisture retention. It's specifically designed for those struggling with frizz and unruly hair, helping to create straight, glossy results. The products feature a Wonder Rose Honey fragrance and are particularly recommended for those wanting to manage wavy or curly hair while achieving a sleek, moisturized finish.

Name: Schick Intuition Razor, Sensitive Skin, Holder With Blade + 1 Replacement Blade
Short description: The Schick Intuition Sensitive Care razor is a specialized shaving system designed for sensitive skin, featuring a built-in moisturizing soap bar infused with aloe vera and tea leaf extracts. The 4-blade pivoting head automatically adjusts to body contours while the integrated soap bar lathers and moisturizes in one step, eliminating the need for separate shaving cream. It includes safety wires to minimize blade contact with skin and a rubber grip for secure handling in wet conditions. This Japanese version is particularly suited for those with sensitive skin who prefer a gentle, simplified shaving routine.

Name: KOSÉ Clear Turn Sorry Bare Skin Mask 7 Sheets
Short description: KOSE Clear Turn Sorry Bare Skin Mask is a Japanese sheet mask designed for sensitive and stressed skin. Each pack contains 7 sheets featuring a unique three-layer cotton material with an embossed surface for enhanced adhesion and gentle exfoliation. The mask is infused with natural ingredients including pomegranate extract, plum extract, and hyaluronic acid to repair and hydrate compromised skin. It's particularly suitable for those with irregular lifestyles or experiencing skin troubles due to external stress. The alcohol-free, fragrance-free, and weakly acidic formula makes it ideal for sensitive skin types. The recommended usage time is 8 minutes, and it's best used 1-2 times per week.

Name: Botanist Treatment, Smooth 460g
Short description: Botanist Treatment Smooth 460g is a premium Japanese hair conditioner designed for deep moisturizing and smoothing effects. This botanical-based treatment features natural plant-derived ingredients including white birch, avocado, and soybean extracts, along with ceramides and hyaluronic acid for intense hydration. The formula is free from synthetic pigments and offers a delightful apple and berry fragrance. Best suited for those seeking to transform dry, damaged hair into silky, smooth locks with natural ingredients. The treatment provides triple care - moisturizing, scalp care, and damage repair - while delivering shine and bounce from root to tip.

Name: Yanagiya Hair Tonic Large 360ml
Short description: Yanagiya Hair Tonic is a long-trusted Japanese medicinal hair care product with over 60 years of heritage. This refreshing tonic contains three medicinal ingredients and natural herbal extracts including Swertia japonica, ginseng, and Sophora flavescens that penetrate the hair roots. The formula helps prevent hair loss, promotes hair growth, reduces dandruff and scalp itching, while providing a cooling sensation. The subtle citrus-scented tonic is best suited for those concerned with hair thinning, scalp care, and those seeking a traditional Japanese approach to hair maintenance. For optimal results, apply 2-3 times daily to a clean, dry scalp with a gentle massage.

Name: Tsujiri Green Lemon Tea 170g
Short description: This is a premium instant green tea powder product from Tsujiri, a renowned Kyoto tea brand established in 1860. The blend combines authentic Uji matcha from Kyoto with fermented lemon juice from Setouchi region and honey, creating a refreshing beverage that can be enjoyed hot or cold. The 170g package contains a powder that dissolves easily in water, offering a perfect balance of matcha's earthiness with citrus brightness and subtle sweetness. It's particularly well-suited for summer refreshment, though enjoyable year-round. Each serving provides a convenient way to experience high-quality Japanese tea with a modern twist.

Name: Diane Extra Fresh & Repair Shampoo Treatment Set
Short description: Diane Extra Fresh & Repair Shampoo Treatment Set is a Japanese summer-exclusive haircare duo featuring a grapefruit and peppermint fragrance. The set contains feather keratin for intensive repair and three refreshing herbs (rosemary, lemongrass, and peppermint) to address oily scalp concerns in humid weather. Enriched with organic argan oil and formulated without silicones and sulfates, it's specifically designed to combat UV damage while providing a lightweight, refreshing finish. Best suited for those dealing with oily scalp, heat-induced scalp irritation, and summer hair damage who want a cooling, refreshing hair care experience.

Name: YOLU Calm Night Repair Treatment 475g
Short description: YOLU Calm Night Repair Treatment is a Japanese hair treatment designed for overnight hair care. This 475g bottle contains a specialized night-cap formula that protects hair from friction and dryness damage during sleep. Enriched with ceramides and beauty serum ingredients, it deeply moisturizes both hair and scalp. The formula is free from parabens, mineral oils, and synthetic colorants. Its soothing fragrance combines neroli and peony notes, perfect for nighttime relaxation. Best suited for damaged, colored, or permed hair, particularly for those seeking to wake up with smoother, more manageable hair.

Name: YOLU Calm Night Repair Shampoo 475ml
Short description: YOLU Calm Night Repair Shampoo is a Japanese silicone-free hair care product designed for overnight hair repair and protection. This innovative shampoo features a unique night cap formula that shields hair from friction and dryness damage while sleeping. Enriched with hydrolyzed keratin, Persian silk tree bark extract, and lotus flower extract, it deeply moisturizes both hair and scalp. The formula is particularly effective for damaged, color-treated, or permed hair, leaving it smooth and silky by morning. Its soothing neroli and peony fragrance promotes relaxation. The product is free from parabens, mineral oils, and synthetic dyes, making it suitable for those seeking gentle yet effective hair care.

Name: Dove Foaming Body Wash Beauty Moisture Plump, Rose Bouquet Scent 540ml
Short description: This Dove Foaming Body Wash is a Japanese body cleanser that delivers premium moisture while cleansing. The innovative pump dispenses approximately 5 million micro-bubbles per push, creating a rich, non-collapsing foam that spreads easily across the skin. Formulated with Niacinamide and pearl essence, it effectively removes impurities from pores while maintaining skin hydration. The formula features a gentle floral fragrance and leaves skin feeling plump and radiant. This body wash is particularly suitable for those seeking a luxurious cleansing experience while maintaining skin moisture, making it ideal for daily use and those with normal to dry skin types.

Name: Laundrin’ Fabric Mist, Classic Floral Scent, 370ml
Short description: Laundrin Fabric Refresher is a premium Japanese fabric and room spray designed to eliminate unwanted odors while leaving a luxurious fragrance. The Classic Floral scent features a sophisticated blend of peach and apple top notes, followed by rose, lily of the valley, and jasmine middle notes, finishing with woody, musk, cedar, and balsamic base notes. This dual-action spray provides antibacterial protection and deodorizing effects, making it perfect for items that can't be washed daily like curtains, sofas, carpets, and clothing. Infused with organic plant extracts, it's ideal for refreshing spaces and fabrics while maintaining a clean, elegant atmosphere.

Name: Dove Body Soap Firm & Moisture, Jasmine Scent 480g
Short description: This Dove body wash is part of their Fermentation & Beauty Series, featuring a unique formula with two types of fermented beauty ingredients (Acerola Cherry and Pomegranate) plus Jasmine extract. The low-molecular-weight fermented ingredients penetrate deep into the skin's layers while removing dead skin cells. It creates rich, luxurious lather and locks in moisture for firmer, more hydrated skin. The body wash has a refreshing jasmine fragrance with subtle fermented notes. Best suited for those with dry skin seeking both firmness and hydration in their daily body care routine.

Name: Replica Notes Fabric Mist, Sensual Fruity Scent, 300ml
Short description: Replica Notes Fabric Mist in Sensual Fruity Scent is a premium fabric refresher spray from Matsumoto Kiyoshi's lifestyle brand. This sophisticated mist combines juicy citrus, raspberry, and peach top notes with floral middle notes of rose, jasmine, and magnolia, finishing with woody and amber base notes. It offers 99.9% antibacterial properties and effectively eliminates common household odors from clothes and fabrics that can't be washed frequently. While the scent is luxurious and long-lasting, some users note it can be quite intense, making it best suited for those who enjoy stronger, sweet fragrances.

Name: Premium Aroma, Fruity, Room Fragrance 400ml
Short description: This is a Premium Aroma room air freshener from S.T. Corporation Japan, featuring a sophisticated floral-fruity fragrance. The product contains specially selected fragrance oils curated by professional perfumers and incorporates nano-powder technology for effective deodorization. The 400ml liquid formulation provides long-lasting fragrance for 2-3 months, with an adjustable cap to control scent intensity. It's ideal for living rooms and entrances, designed to create an elegant, perfume-like atmosphere while effectively eliminating unwanted odors.

Name: Diane Deep Night Moist Shampoo 450ml
Short description: Diane Deep Night Moist Shampoo is a premium Japanese hair care product designed for overnight repair and deep moisturizing. The shampoo features organic argan oil and hydrolyzed keratin with HYDROMAGIC® and WAVE CANCELLER® technology to provide intensive moisture retention and frizz control. Formulated without silicones, sulfates, and parabens, it's particularly effective for brittle, damaged, and unruly hair. The product has a calming moonlight berry fragrance combining fresh fruits with floral and woody notes. Best suited for those who regularly use heat styling or chemical treatments and need intensive overnight repair while maintaining color-safe protection.

Name: KUNDAL Body Lotion, Baby Powder Scent, 500ml
Short description: This KUNDAL Honey & Macadamia Body Lotion in Baby Powder scent is a Korean skincare product featuring a blend of natural ingredients, including aloe vera leaf extract, honey, and macadamia seed extract. The lotion offers dual benefits of whitening and anti-aging properties through niacinamide while providing intense hydration. Its lightweight formula absorbs quickly without stickiness, leaving skin nourished and softly scented with a gentle baby powder fragrance. Best suited for those seeking daily moisturization with a subtle, comforting scent and brightening benefits.

Name: Salonia 2-Way Straighten & Curl Hair Iron, 32 mm, Professional Use, 428°F (220°C), Beige
Short description: The Salonia 2-Way Hair Iron is a versatile styling tool that combines both straightening and curling functions in one device, featuring a 32mm ceramic-coated barrel. With professional-grade heating up to 220°C (428°F), it reaches styling temperature in just 50 seconds. The device offers precise temperature control in 5°C increments, includes safety features like auto-shutoff after 30 minutes, and is compatible with worldwide voltage (100V-240V). Best suited for users who want salon-quality versatility at home and frequently switch between straight and curled styles.

Name: WetBrush Original Detangler Rapunzel Hair Brush
Short description: The WetBrush Original Detangler Rapunzel Hair Brush is a Disney Princess-themed detangling brush featuring Rapunzel's elegant portrait design on a silver-toned handle. This versatile brush is equipped with ultra-soft IntelliFlex bristles that effortlessly glide through tangles while minimizing pain and protecting against split ends and breakage. Suitable for both wet and dry hair, it works effectively on all hair types, including wigs and extensions. The brush embodies Rapunzel's adventurous spirit and is perfect for those seeking a gentle yet effective detangling solution with a touch of Disney magic.

Name: SALONIA Straight Hair Iron, 24mm, Purple Limited Edition
Short description: The Salonia My Nuance hair straightener is a limited edition 2024 autumn/winter styling tool featuring a sophisticated purple metallic finish. This versatile straightener offers temperature control ranging from 120°C to 230°C with a quick 30-second heat-up time. It comes with ceramic-coated plates for smooth gliding and reduced hair damage, a 360-degree rotating cord for easy handling, and an auto-shutoff function for safety.
