Perfect for daily use on both babies and family members who prefer a gentle, fragranced moisturizer.

Name: Ma & Me Latte Body Wash 490ml + Refill 360ml, For Parants and Children, Apple and Peony Scent
Short description: Ma & Me Latte is a Japanese skincare body wash designed for both parents and children, featuring a dual-care system with Premium W Milk Protein. The creamy, dense foam cleanses while protecting the skin's moisture barrier. It contains ceramides, yeast extract, and milk-derived proteins to address different skin concerns across age groups. Sulfate-free and dermatologically tested, this gentle cleanser has a pleasant apple and peony fragrance. The product comes in a 490ml pump bottle with a 360ml refill option, making it ideal for shared family use.

Name: Nichiban Roihi Tsuboko Hot Patch 78pcs
Short description: Roihi Tsuboko is a Japanese medicinal hot patch designed for pain relief. These round, beige-colored patches contain active ingredients like methyl salicylate and vanillamide nonylate that create a warming sensation to improve blood circulation. The coin-sized patches are specifically effective for shoulder stiffness, lower back pain, muscle soreness, sprains, and joint discomfort. With Nichiban's unique adhesive technology, they stay firmly in place during movement while remaining discreet on the skin. Each box contains 78 waterproof patches that can be easily applied to targeted areas.

Name: VT COSMETICS Pro Cica Spot Pimple Patch Neon Edition
Short description: The VT COSMETICS Pro Cica Spot Pimple Patch Neon Edition is a Korean skincare product featuring transparent hydrocolloid patches infused with Centella Asiatica extract. The pack contains 63 patches in various sizes, including unique heart-shaped neon patches that glow in the dark and regular circular patches. These waterproof, adhesive patches protect blemishes while absorbing impurities and reducing redness. Best suited for those seeking both functional acne care and playful aesthetics, particularly during nighttime or events where the glow-in-the-dark feature adds a fun element.

Name: Bifesta Lip Serum Mask
Short description: The Bifesta Lip Serum Mask is an overnight lip treatment pack from Japanese brand Mandom. This 8g preservative-free formula features three key moisturizing ingredients: squalane, orange oil, and vitamin E. The dense serum mask adheres closely to lips, providing intense hydration throughout the night while visually minimizing vertical lip lines. Suitable for both nighttime and daytime use, this paraben-free, alcohol-free, and synthetic fragrance-free treatment helps achieve plump, moisturized lips.

Name: [SALE] Melano CC Medicated Stain Concentration Prevention Premium Serum
Short description: This is Rohto's Melano CC Premium Essence, a Japanese medical-grade vitamin C serum designed for intensive spot treatment and prevention. The concentrated formula features active Vitamin C, three Vitamin C derivatives, Vitamin B6, and allantoin in a unique oil-like texture that absorbs quickly without residue. The product comes in a specialized tube with a ball-tip applicator to prevent oxidation. It's particularly effective for those concerned with hyperpigmentation, acne scars, and uneven skin tone, while also providing antibacterial and sebum control benefits.

Name: Verdio UV Moisture Gel 80g
Short description: Verdio UV Moisture Gel is a Japanese sunscreen designed for sensitive skin, offering high protection with SPF50+ and PA++++. This lightweight, non-sticky gel formula is free from fragrances, colorants, mineral oils, parabens, and ethanol. It features beneficial ingredients like CICA (Centella Asiatica), pearl barley, moringa, and edelweiss extracts for moisturizing effects. The waterproof and sweat-resistant formula protects against UV rays, pollen, and PM2.5 particles while remaining easily removable with soap. Ideal for daily use on both face and body, including children's sensitive skin.

Name: Club Suppin Powder, Pastel Rose Scent
Short description: Club Suppin Powder in Pastel Rose Scent is a Japanese skincare powder designed to be worn overnight without washing off. This 26g powder features fine particles that provide a natural, matte finish while protecting skincare products underneath. It contains moisturizing ingredients like hyaluronic acid and collagen, along with oil-absorbing components. The powder helps reduce shine, blur imperfections, and has a delicate rose fragrance. Perfect for those who want to control nighttime skincare product absorption or desire a natural bare-skin look during the day.

Name: Club Suppin Powder, White Floral Bouquet Scent
Short description: Club Suppin Powder with White Floral Bouquet Scent is a unique Japanese skincare-infused setting powder that doesn't require removal before bed. This 26g powder features ultra-fine particles that seamlessly blend into the skin without looking powdery, transforming from white to a subtle beige tone to prevent white cast. Enriched with moisturizing ingredients, it provides a natural, flawless finish while protecting skin from environmental impurities. Perfect for those seeking a low-maintenance beauty routine or wanting to achieve a natural "no-makeup" look.

Name: CANMAKE Mermaid Skin Gel UV 01
Short description: The Canmake Mermaid Skin Gel UV 01 Clear is a Japanese sunscreen that offers SPF50+ PA++++ protection in a lightweight, watery gel format. This alcohol-free and fragrance-free formula doubles as a moisturizing makeup primer while providing strong UV protection. The clear, colorless gel breaks down into a water-like texture upon application, leaving a dewy finish without white cast. Best suited for normal to combination skin types seeking a gentle, everyday sunscreen that works well under makeup. Contains 85% beautifying ingredients and is easily removable with regular face wash.

Name: REVLON Kiss Lip Sugar Scrub, Sweet Sakura 325
Short description: This is a limited edition REVLON Kiss Sugar Scrub in Sweet Sakura (325) featuring Sanrio's My Melody design. It's a 2-in-1 stick-type lip treatment that combines a sugar scrub for gentle exfoliation with a moisturizing balm. The formula contains three fruit oils (pomegranate, raspberry, and grape seed) for hydration. With a delicate cherry blossom fragrance, it leaves lips smooth and plump without needing to rinse. Particularly effective as a night treatment for soft, glossy lips by morning.

Name: REVLON Kiss Lip Sugar Scrub, Cool Mint 321
Short description: REVLON Kiss Sugar Scrub is a dual-action lip care product that combines exfoliating sugar crystals with moisturizing fruit oils. This stick-type balm gently removes dead skin cells while providing 24-hour hydration. Infused with pomegranate, raspberry, and grape seed oils, it leaves lips smooth and plump. The sugar crystals dissolve naturally, requiring no rinsing. With a refreshing mint flavor, it's ideal for those seeking both exfoliation and moisture in one convenient product, perfect as a lip color base or nighttime treatment.

Name: REVLON Kiss Lip Sugar Scrub, Peppermint 324
Short description: This limited edition Revlon Kiss Sugar Scrub in Peppermint (324) features a special Sanrio Hangyodon character design. It's a 2-in-1 stick-type lip care product that combines sugar crystals for gentle exfoliation with moisturizing fruit oils like pomegranate seed oil. The formula provides 24-hour hydration while the peppermint flavor offers a refreshing sensation. Perfect for daily use, it can be applied before lipstick application or as an overnight treatment for smooth, plump lips. The thick crayon-like design allows for easy, mess-free application.

Name: Deo Carat Medicated Deodorant Stick
Short description: Deo Carat Medicated Deodorant Stick is a Japanese antiperspirant that effectively stops underarm sweat and prevents odor. This 20g stick features a high-adhesion formula that provides long-lasting protection with a silky smooth application that dries instantly. Enriched with beauty ingredients like CICA, golden extract, and green tea extract, it leaves skin feeling fresh while preventing sweat stains. The product offers a relaxing aromatic floral scent and is best suited for those seeking reliable sweat and odor control with skin-caring benefits.

Name: Mentholatum Repair One Night Care Lip, For Chapped and Dryness Lip
Short description: The Mentholatum Repair ONE Night Care Lip is a Japanese lip essence designed for overnight intensive care. This tube-type lip treatment contains three key beauty serum ingredients: hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and retinol. It features a unique vertical wrinkle-sealing formula that fills lip crevices while providing deep moisturization. Perfect for those struggling with chapped or dry lips, this overnight treatment helps achieve plump, moisturized lips by morning. Made by Rohto Pharmaceutical in Japan, it's particularly effective during dry seasons.

Name: Body Fantasies Body Mist, Cotton Candy 50ml
Short description: Body Fantasies Body Spray in Cotton Candy Sweet is a playful fragrance mist featuring a sweet strawberry cotton candy scent. The pink bottle with a cute teddy bear design embodies its youthful appeal. Initially strong when sprayed, it settles into a soft, warm sweetness with notes of vanilla, sugar, raspberry, strawberry, and musk. Most popular among teenagers and those in their early 20s, this body mist is perfect for those who enjoy sweet, dessert-like fragrances without being overwhelmingly sugary.

Name: Body Fantasies Body Mist, Sweet Peony 50ml
Short description: Body Fantasies Sweet Peony is a 50ml body mist spray featuring a romantic floral fragrance with sweet peony notes enhanced by berry accents. This Japanese body spray offers a feminine, clean scent that balances sweetness with sophistication. Perfect for those who prefer a delicate yet noticeable fragrance, it's designed for easy carrying and quick application anytime. The formula provides a refreshing mist that's ideal for daily use, particularly appealing to those who enjoy floral scents with a fruity twist.

Name: CANMAKE Cream Cheek 21
Short description: CANMAKE Cream Cheek 21 "Tangerine Tea" is a Japanese cream blush with a unique gel-cream texture that transforms into a powder finish upon application. This coral-beige shade offers a natural flush particularly flattering on warm-toned skin. The formula features vegetable squalane and amino acid emollients for moisture retention, while being water, sweat, and sebum-resistant. The product melts seamlessly into the skin for a dewy, natural finish and can be layered for customizable intensity. Compatible with both liquid and powder foundations, this compact blush is ideal for achieving a fresh, healthy complexion.

Name: CANMAKE Cream Cheek 16
Short description: CANMAKE Cream Cheek is a popular Japanese cream blush with a unique melting gel texture that transforms into a dry finish upon application. The product features a geometric embossed design and comes in a compact clear case. This award-winning formula blends seamlessly into the skin, creating a natural, dewy flush that appears to radiate from within. Perfect for those seeking a buildable, long-lasting cream blush that works well over both powder and liquid foundations. The formula is enriched with skin-friendly ingredients like squalane and amino acid-based emollients for added moisture.

Name: Nivea Premium Moisture Body Lotion + Mini Nivea UV Deep Protect & Care
Short description: This is a Nivea Premium set featuring a full-size Premium Body Milk (likely the Moisture variant) paired with a mini Nivea UV Deep Protect & Care sunscreen. The UV product offers powerful SPF50+ PA++++ protection against both UVA and UVB rays, helping prevent sun-induced spots and freckles. It contains beauty essence agents including Japanese honeysuckle flower extract, pearl protein extract, and Damask rose water. The waterproof gel formula can be used on both face and body as a makeup base, with a pleasant floral scent. Ideal for those seeking effective sun protection with added skincare benefits.

Name: Diane Deep Night Moist Refill Set, Shampoo Treatment 600ml
Short description: Diane Perfect Beauty Deep Night Moist Refill Shampoo is a high-penetration moisturizing hair product from Japan. This 660ml refill pack features organic argan oil and moisture keratin to provide deep hydration while controlling frizz and waves. The non-silicone formula uses HydroMagic and WaveCanceller technologies to maintain moisture and manage unruly hair. With a pleasant Moonlight Berry fragrance combining fruity and floral notes, it's ideal for those with dry, frizzy, or wavy hair seeking smoother, more manageable results.

Name: Ipoddo Tea Matcha Powder, Ikuyo-no-mukashi 30g Box
Short description: Ippodo's Ikuyo-no-mukashi is a medium-bodied matcha powder from Kyoto, Japan. This 30g box contains high-quality green tea powder with a refreshing bitterness balanced with subtle sweetness and umami. Perfect for matcha beginners, it has a clean taste that pairs well with sweets, fruits, and pastries. Named by the grand master of the Ura-Senke tea family, it can be enjoyed as usucha (thin tea), in lattes, or during snack time like coffee or tea. Best prepared with 80°C water and whisked vigorously for optimal flavor.

Name: FIANCEE Body Mist, White Floral Scent
Short description: FIANCEE Body Mist in White Floral is an award-winning Japanese fragrance mist that offers a delicate, transparent floral scent. It features top notes of fresh pineapple and raspberry, middle notes of lily of the valley, jasmine, and rose, and base notes of amber and musk. This gentle, shampoo-like scent is perfect for daily use in school or office settings where stronger fragrances might be inappropriate. Its subtle, clean fragrance provides a refreshing touch without being overpowering, making it a bestseller in Japan.

Name: FIANCEE Body Mist, Cherry Blossom Scent
Short description: FIANCEE Body Mist Sakura Scent R is a limited edition fragrance mist that captures the essence of standing beneath cherry blossoms in full bloom. This 50ml body spray features a delicate, clean floral scent with top notes of peach, apricot, and lychee, middle notes of cherry blossom, lily of the valley, and rose, and base notes of musk and amber. The gentle fragrance makes it perfect for fragrance beginners and can be applied to wrists and neck. Ideal for spring wear with its elegant, pure cherry blossom aroma.

Name: FIANCEE Body Mist Tokyo Scent
Short description: FIANCEE Body Mist is a Japanese fragrance product that offers a gentle, refreshing scent reminiscent of freshly shampooed hair. This light body spray features a delicate blend of floral and fruity notes, including lemon, green apple, and jasmine. It's designed for everyday use, suitable for school, office, or dates. The mist provides a subtle, clean aroma that's not overpowering, making it ideal for fragrance beginners or those who prefer a more understated scent. It's best for those seeking a fresh, shower-clean feeling throughout the day.

Name: FIANCEE Body Mist, Apple Scent
Short description: FIANCEE Body Mist in Apple Scent is a refreshing Japanese fragrance that offers the sweet aroma of ripe red apples with honey notes. The scent progresses from a cute, slightly tart apple and cassis top note to a sweet caramelized middle note with floral hints of freesia and lily. It finishes with gentle woody and musk undertones for a pure, clean impression. This body mist is perfect for those who prefer light, fruity fragrances and is designed to evoke a sense of young romance and give confidence. Ideal for everyday wear.

Name: Aqua Savon Perfume EDP, Sakura Limited Edition
Short description: Aqua Savon's Sakura Floral Eau de Toilette is a limited edition spring fragrance that combines the beloved scent of cherry blossoms with a clean soap aroma. This Japanese perfume features a delicate blend of cherry, blackcurrant, green apple, and citrus top notes, with floral heart notes and a musky amber base. The soft, feminine scent is perfect for those who prefer subtle fragrances and is ideal for everyday wear during spring and summer. The pretty pink bottle with floating beads adds a charming touch to any vanity.

Name: Liquid Muhi S2a 50ml, For Itchiness and Redness
Short description: Liquid Muhi S2a (50ml) is a Japanese topical medication for quick relief of itching, swelling, and redness from insect bites, rashes, and skin irritations. It contains two key active ingredients: diphenhydramine hydrochloride to quickly relieve itching and dexamethasone acetate to reduce inflammation. The liquid formula provides a refreshing cooling sensation with menthol and camphor. Features a convenient sponge applicator for mess-free use. Suitable for ages 6 months and older. Ideal for treating mosquito bites, hives, eczema, and heat rash.

Name: SANA Nameraka Honpo Soy Isoflavone All-in-One Gel
Short description: SANA Namerakahonpo Thick Concentrated Gel is a 6-in-1 all-in-one skincare product containing fermented soy milk and high-purity soy isoflavones. This multifunctional gel replaces lotion, serum, emulsion, cream, pack, and makeup base in one step. Its unique memory gel texture melts into the skin for deep hydration without stickiness, making it perfect for both morning and evening routines. Ideal for busy people seeking simplified skincare with effective moisturization. Fragrance-free, colorant-free, and mineral oil-free.

Name: Koisuru Oshiri Hip Care Soap
Short description: Koisuru Oshiri (Lovely Bottom) Hip Care Soap is a Japanese exfoliating soap designed specifically for buttocks and thighs. This peach-scented scrub soap contains dual exfoliants from peach kernels and konjac to remove dead skin cells, address darkening, roughness, and bumps. Enriched with six moisturizing essences including peach leaf extract, peach seed extract, and aloe vera juice, it helps maintain necessary hydration while improving skin texture. Simply wet the soap and massage in circular motions on problem areas for smoother, brighter skin. Perfect for anyone looking to improve the appearance of their hip area.

Name: Sana Nameraka Honpo Medicated Wrinkle Serum, White 50ml
Short description: Sana Namerakahonpo Medicated Wrinkle Essence White is a Japanese anti-aging serum (50ml) designed for skin showing early signs of aging. This quasi-drug formula contains niacinamide and pure retinol to boost collagen production, improve elasticity, and reduce melanin for a brighter complexion. Enriched with fermented soy milk from Tamahomare soybeans rich in isoflavones, it deeply nourishes without stickiness. Ideal for women over 30 with dry or combination skin concerned about fine lines, wrinkles, and hyperpigmentation. Fragrance-free and paraben-free.

Name: LUCIDO-L #EX Hair Oil Smooth 80ml
Short description: LUCIDO-L Argan Rich Oil Hair Treatment Oil Smooth is a lightweight, non-greasy hair oil formulated with Moroccan argan oil. This 80ml product is designed to repair damaged hair, treat split ends, and leave a natural, healthy shine. It offers UV and heat protection while creating a moisture-retaining film on each hair strand. The oil is best suited for those with fine, soft, or thin hair who desire tangle-free, smooth, and silky locks. Its high-pressure processing technology ensures quick absorption and even coating for a feather-light, elegant finish.

Name: LUCIDO-L #EX Hair Oil Repair 80ml
Short description: LUCIDO-L #EX Hair Repair Oil is a leave-in treatment designed to repair damaged hair and provide deep moisture. This 80ml product contains high-pressure processed argan oil, which coats each hair strand for intense hydration without feeling heavy. It features heat protection to guard against styling damage, UV protection, and a light floral fragrance. The oil is particularly effective for those with dry, damaged hair prone to frizz and split ends, leaving hair soft, silky, and shiny. Best suited for users seeking to restore and protect their hair from daily styling and environmental stressors.

Name: Johnson’s Body Care Bright Lotion, Jasmine and White Lily, 500ml
Short description: Johnson's Body Vibrant Radiance Aroma Milk is a premium body lotion featuring jasmine and white lily fragrance. This 500ml pump bottle contains a moisturizing formula with baby oil, niacinamide, and vitamin C derivatives that penetrate deep into the skin's layers. It provides intense hydration without stickiness, helping to achieve translucent, radiant skin. The non-greasy texture makes it perfect for daily use on normal to dry skin, offering both skincare benefits and a pleasant floral scent for a relaxing experience.

Name: Ululis Pinkme Water Conc Control Shampoo Treatment Set, Blossom Tea Limited Edition
Short description: Ululis Pinkme Water Conc Control Shampoo Treatment Set, Blossom Tea Limited Edition is a Japanese hair care product designed for those with frizzy or unruly hair. This set features a shampoo and treatment with a unique "water pack beauty" formula, containing 90% hydrating and repair ingredients. It aims to achieve 15% hair moisture content, controlling frizz and enhancing manageability. The products are infused with 10 water-soluble beauty ingredients and feature a delicate cherry blossom tea fragrance. Ideal for those seeking smoother, more manageable hair with a touch of luxury.

Name: Ululis Pinkme Water Conc Control Shampoo Treatment Set, Kuromi Limited Edition
Short description: This is the Ululis PINKme Kuromi Limited Edition Control Shampoo & Treatment Set, a special collaboration with Sanrio's Kuromi character (ranked 3rd in the 2024 Sanrio Character Awards). Released on October 28, 2024, this set features Kuromi's signature black hood and pink skull design. The products use "Wave Control Beauty" technology to manage frizzy hair by balancing internal moisture, preventing external moisture absorption, and repairing hair inside and out. It has a sweet grape fragrance "picked by Kuromi" and is ideal for those with wavy or frizzy hair seeking smoother, more hydrated locks.

Name: Ululis Kirameki Water Conc Shiny Shampoo Treatment Set, Kinmokusei Limited Edition
Short description: Ululis Kinmokusei Kirameki is a limited-edition organic hair care set featuring shampoo and treatment with a sweet, romantic osmanthus (kinmokusei) fragrance. This product focuses on increasing hair's internal moisture content, with over 90% beauty essence ingredients that repair and protect cuticles. The "Water Pack" technology creates shiny, lustrous hair, making it ideal for those with coarse, dull hair lacking shine. This is part of Ululis' popular seasonal osmanthus series, which is being discontinued after this year's release.

Name: Ululis Pinkme Water Conc Control Shampoo 340ml
Short description: Ululis Pinkme Water Conc Control Shampoo (340ml) is a Japanese hair care product designed for frizzy, unruly hair with a focus on inner-dry hair concerns. It features a "new wave control beauty" approach with 90% hydrating and wave-care ingredients, including 10 water-soluble beauty serum components. The shampoo has a pleasant Shabon Rose fragrance and comes in an attractive pink double-structure bottle that enhances light protection and moisture retention. Best for those with wavy, curly hair seeking smoother, more manageable results.

Name: Ululis Pinkme Water Conc Control Treatment 340ml
Short description: Ululis PINKme Water Conc Control Treatment is a premium hair treatment designed specifically for inner-dry hair. This Japanese product focuses on maintaining optimal moisture levels (targeting 15% water content) to control frizz and unruly hair. Formulated with 10 water-soluble beauty serum ingredients including collagen, ceramide, and royal jelly extract, it wraps hair in beauty water to provide deep hydration. Ideal for those with wavy, curly, or damaged hair who want smoother, more manageable locks. Features a pleasant Aqua Pink fragrance.

Name: KOSÉ Clear Turn Mask Pore Tightening 7 Sheets
Short description: KOSE Clear Turn Pore Komachi Shine Genji Face Mask is a Japanese sheet mask designed for oily, combination, and problematic skin. It contains retinol, Centella Asiatica (CICA), and rice fermentation extract to regulate sebum production, tighten pores, and treat inflammation. The mask features a special Bemliese® cotton fiber that's 30% thinner than conventional masks, allowing better penetration of active ingredients. With 7 masks per package and a relaxing floral scent, it provides intensive care in just 8 minutes, leaving skin hydrated, balanced, and with a smooth porcelain-like finish.

Name: Hatomugi Beauty Mask 7 Sheets
Short description: The Hatomugi Beauty Mask is a Japanese sheet mask pack containing 7 sheets. Infused with coix seed (hatomugi) extract, amino acids, and hot spring water, it aims to brighten and moisturize the skin. The mask is made from a soft, washi paper-like material that adheres well to the face. It's designed to provide multiple skincare benefits, including hydration, tone evening, and reducing the appearance of dark spots. This mask is best suited for those looking to achieve a brighter, more radiant complexion and is suitable for various skin types.

Name: Hatomugi Beauty Mask 30 Sheets
Short description: The Eve Hatomugi Beauty Mask is a Japanese sheet mask containing 30 pieces that gently wraps the skin to prevent dryness and rough skin. It features six skin-smoothing and moisturizing ingredients including placenta extract, adlay seed extract, ceramide, sodium hyaluronate, himefuuro extract, and neem leaf extract. Rich in plant-based oils and natural moisturizing factors, hatomugi (Job's tears) helps retain moisture, brighten skin tone, reduce dark spots, and provide anti-inflammatory benefits. Ideal for those seeking deep hydration and a more radiant complexion.

Name: TSUBAKI Argan Oil Shampoo Treatment Set
Short description: The TSUBAKI Argan Oil Shampoo Treatment Set is a premium Japanese hair care duo featuring argan and tsubaki (camellia) oils. This set is designed to nourish, repair, and add volume to damaged hair. Key benefits include deep moisturization, frizz reduction, and enhanced shine. The formula contains a blend of natural oils and amino acids to strengthen hair from root to tip. Ideal for those with dry, damaged, or lifeless hair seeking a luxurious, salon-quality treatment at home. The set offers a captivating floral scent and promises visible results from the first use.

Name: White Conc Body Lotion 245ml
Short description: White Conc Body Lotion CII is a Japanese medicated whitening body spray (245ml) that helps prevent spots and freckles by suppressing melanin production. This watery-textured mist contains vitamin C derivatives and glycyrrhizinate dipotassium as active ingredients. With a refreshing grapefruit fragrance, it's perfect for summer use as it absorbs quickly without stickiness. Ideal for hard-to-reach areas like the back and particularly effective on rough areas such as elbows, knees, and heels. Best suited for those seeking body brightening without heavy moisture.

Name: &Honey Milky Precious Ex Repair Refill Set + Free &Honey Melty Hand Cream
Short description: This is the &Honey Milky Precious EX Repair Refill Set with a free &Honey Melty Moist Hand Cream. The set includes refills for shampoo and hair treatment from the premium &Honey Milky line, which features Milk Honey and Keratin Honey ingredients for intensive damage repair and deep moisturization. The products help repair hair damaged from heat styling and coloring while leaving it silky smooth. The included hand cream provides excellent moisturization for dry skin, especially during winter. Ideal for those with damaged, dry hair seeking effective repair with a pleasant berry sweet honey fragrance.

Name: Essential Premium Water Treatment EX Smooth
Short description: Essential Premium Water Treatment EX Smooth is a leave-in hair treatment from Kao Japan. This water-based formula penetrates deeply to create smooth, silky hair that lasts all day. Key benefits include: repairs and prevents heat damage, speeds up blow-drying time, prevents static electricity, and contains natural 18-MEA oil (lanolin fatty acid) plus moisturizing ingredients like hydrolyzed collagen and lactic acid. Ideal for damaged, tangled hair that needs smoothing. Features a luxurious floral scent with gardenia and jasmine notes. Best applied to towel-dried hair before blow-drying.

Name: TSUBAKI Premium Repair Hair Water 220ml
Short description: TSUBAKI Premium Repair Hair Water is a leave-in hair treatment spray by Shiseido. This innovative product, inspired by salon treatments, deeply nourishes and repairs damaged, dry, and chemically treated hair. Its formula contains camellia oil, royal jelly extract, and soy protein to penetrate the hair core, providing intense hydration and strengthening. The lightweight mist reduces brittleness, prevents split ends, and adds shine without weighing hair down. With a pleasant floral-fruity scent, it's suitable for both wet and dry hair, making it ideal for daily use to achieve salon-like results at home.

Name: ORBIS Treatment Hair Water 180ml
Short description: ORBIS Treatment Hair Water is a leave-in hair mist that provides salon-like treatment for damaged, unruly hair. This award-winning product contains beauty serum ingredients including 18-MEA similar components, hyaluronic acid, and amino acids that repair and protect hair. The fine mist formula tames bed hair, adds shine, and prevents heat damage from styling tools. It can be used on both wet and dry hair, is fragrance-free, and is perfect for daily use. Ideal for those seeking easy hair care that moisturizes and smooths without weighing hair down.

Name: Body Fantasies Body Mist, Pure Soap 94ml
Short description: Body Fantasies Body Spray in Pure Soap scent is a popular Japanese fragrance product. This 94ml body mist offers a gentle, clean soap aroma that's universally appealing. It's designed for easy application, allowing users to refresh their scent throughout the day with just a quick spritz. Ideal for those who prefer subtle, comforting fragrances, this body spray is perfect for everyday use. Its light formula makes it suitable for all skin types and can be layered with other scents for a personalized fragrance experience.

Name: Body Fantasies Body Mist, White Musk 94ml
Short description: Body Fantasies Body Spray White Musk (94ml) is a refreshing fragrance featuring a beautiful bouquet of bright white florals combined with soft sensual woods and clean white musks. This portable, travel-sized spray contains a higher concentration of fragrance oils (6%) than competitors. With notes of lily of the valley, rose, jasmine, and vanilla, it offers a clean, feminine scent perfect for everyday wear. Ideal for those seeking a light, long-lasting fragrance that provides all-day freshness without being overwhelming.

Name: Body Fantasies Body Mist, White Musk 50ml
Short description: Body Fantasies Body Spray in Fresh White Musk is a light fragrance featuring a clean, elegant scent that combines white florals with soft sensual woods and clean white musk. This 50ml spray offers a refreshing option for everyday use, providing a gentle yet noticeable fragrance that creates a sense of purity and cleanliness. The scent evolves beautifully over time, becoming warmer and more sophisticated as it melds with your skin. Perfect for those who appreciate subtle, fresh fragrances with good staying power.

Name: Melano CC Medicinal Whitening Lotion, Moist Type 170ml
Short description: Melano CC Medicinal Whitening Lotion Moist Type is a Japanese skincare product designed to target dark spots and hyperpigmentation while providing hydration. This pharmaceutical-grade whitening toner contains highly penetrative Vitamin C derivatives that deeply absorb into the skin, inhibiting melanin production to prevent freckles and spots. Formulated with anti-inflammatory ingredients and three moisturizing extracts (Alpinia White, lemon, and grapefruit), it's particularly effective for post-acne concerns. The refreshing citrus-scented lotion helps achieve translucent skin while maintaining moisture. Ideal for those seeking both brightening effects and hydration in their skincare routine.

Name: Oshima Tsubaki Multipurpose Oil 40ml
Short description: Oshima Tsubaki is a 100% pure camellia oil extracted from the seeds of the Camellia japonica flower. This multi-purpose oil can be used for hair, scalp, face, and body care. Rich in oleic fatty acids (omega 9) that are compatible with human sebum, it provides excellent moisturizing and anti-aging benefits without clogging pores. The oil protects hair from heat damage, prevents dandruff, stimulates skin cell regeneration, and absorbs quickly without stickiness or fragrance. Best for those seeking a natural, versatile skincare and haircare solution.

Name: Oshima Tsubaki Hair Water 180ml
Short description: Oshima Tsubaki Hair Water is a moisturizing hair mist from Japan containing camellia oil and camellia ceramide. This quick-use spray repairs damaged hair by coating the cuticle while protecting against heat damage from blow dryers and UV rays. Free from fragrances, colorants, and mineral oils, it reduces frizz, prevents static, and adds shine. Ideal for busy mornings, it works on both wet and dry hair, making it perfect for those seeking to tame unruly hair, fix bed head, or add moisture before styling. The bottle features a convenient lock mechanism for portability.

Name: Laundrin’ Fabric Mist, Sakura Scent, 370ml
Short description: Laundrin' Fabric Mist Sakura Cherry Blossom 2025 is a limited edition 370ml spray that freshens fabrics and spaces with a delicate floral fragrance. This Japanese product combines fresh cherry and soft musk notes with layers of peach, green tea, sakura, and amber. It effectively eliminates unpleasant odors from tobacco, food, and pets while providing antibacterial properties. Perfect for curtains, sofas, carpets, coats, shoes, and bags that can't be washed daily. The pretty pink bottle design captures the essence of spring.

Name: Febreze Premium Disinfecting and Deodorizing, Sakura Scent, 370ml
Short description: Febreze Premium Disinfectant and Deodorizing Spray is a limited edition 370ml product featuring a 2025 Sakura (cherry blossom) scent.
